Reach level 10 and cheer up fifteen creatures in the Sporewood. Then you'll become a Pillow Champion. Master Pillowcase would be proud.

vadsrijk.npc.q.adv10_knuffelridder.tekst: You've grown strong as a Snuggle Knight. Prove it in the Sporewood, and you'll become a Pillow Champion.

Reach level 20 and cheer up the Overshroom in the Shroom Temple. Then I'll hold the grand ceremony.

vadsrijk.npc.q.adv20_knuffelridder.klaar: The bells are ringing, the little ears are flapping. I hereby name you Wahoog Paladin! The whole Chonkdom is proud of you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.adv20_knuffelridder.tekst: The highest title of zone 1: Wahoog Paladin. Reach level 20 and cheer up the Overshroom.

vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.bezig: A Mika spy in our very own city... Find him, adventurer. The Order is counting on you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.doel.1: Unmask Akim the Cheese Guh at the market (click on him)
vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.doel.2: Catch the Mika spy on the rooftops of Shroomsbury
vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.klaar.0: A Mika spy! In our very own city, at our very own market. With cheese! And nobody noticed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.klaar.2: That should have tipped us off. He was spying on the temple and the Snuggle Door. The Mikas want something in the Order temple. But what?
vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.klaar.3: Thanks to you, we now know they're everywhere. The Order will be more watchful. Here, a reward for the sharpest sniffer-outer in the Chonkdom.
vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.tekst: Something isn't right in Shroomsbury. Strange clues are scattered all over the realm: black fluff, paw prints, a torn disguise... Find all five. Then you'll know who the traitor is, and you can unmask him.
vadsrijk.npc.q.geheim_spion.titel: Who Is Akim the Cheese Guh?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.aanbod.0: Nyeg! There you are at last! A real, fresh recruit! Welcome to Camp Snuggle, the training island of The Snuggle Order. I'm Sergeant Fluffball.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.aanbod.1: Hi! I'm here to sign up. What does The Snuggle Order actually do?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.aanbod.2: We cheer up whatever has turned grumpy! In The Chonkdom, creatures are turning gray and grouchy. We call it the Chonklessness. We give them their chonk back. With a pillow. Or an arrow. Or a fireball. Very lovingly.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.aanbod.3: Head to the campfire on the square. Cook Crispycrust is sitting there. Tell him I sent you, and you'll get something tasty.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.bezig: The campfire, recruit! Straight ahead, past the tents. You'll smell it soon enough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.klaar.0: Aha! A recruit! Fluffball sent you, huh? Have a seat. Here, a warm fluff cake.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.klaar.1: It's a little black on the bottom.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.klaar.2: That's how it's supposed to be! Rule number one of the Order: whoever wants to give chonk has to eat well first. After that, go see Sister Softly at the little temple in the southwest. She'll help you choose your path.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq01_welkom.tekst: You've arrived by airship at Camp Snuggle, the training island of The Snuggle Order. Sergeant Fluffball sends you to the campfire on the square, where Cook Crispycrust is waiting for you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.aanbod.0: Welcome to the little temple, dear recruit. Every path of The Snuggle Order begins here.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.aanbod.1: The Snuggle Knight stands at the front, with sword, club or hammer, and protects the others. The Fluff Hunter stays at a distance and shoots with a bow or slingshot. The Chonk Mage plays with the elements and heals their friends.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.aanbod.2: Every class has its own level and its own skills. Later you can switch in the great Order temple of Shroomsbury. So just choose with your heart. Are you ready?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.bezig: Take your time, sweetie. Click on me again if you want to see the choice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.doel.0: Choose a class at the little temple
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.klaar.0: What a lovely choice. I can tell by your little ears: that suits you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.klaar.1: Now go to the training field in the northeast. Master Pillowcase will show you how to bop. Gently, but right on target.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq02_pad.tekst: At the class temple you choose your first path: Snuggle Knight (up close, sturdy), Fluff Hunter (from afar, fast) or Chonk Mage (elements and healing). Later you can always switch in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.aanbod.0: Aha, a new one! I'm Master Pillowcase. I teach recruits to bop. Gentle bopping.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.aanbod.1: Left-click is your normal attack. With R, V and G you use your skills, which cost some energy. And Z is your ultimate skill: it charges up while you fight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.aanbod.2: Go ahead and bop those training dummies six times. They can take it. They're made of hay and good spirits.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.bezig: Six bops on the dummies! Go on, they won't feel a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.klaar.0: Well, look at that! Nicely done. That dummy is absolutely delighted with you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.klaar.1: Here, your first real weapon. See that beam of light? The color tells you how rare something is: gray, green, blue, purple, orange... and very rarely pink. Pink is guhvine!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.klaar.2: One more important thing, recruit. Ever get stuck? In a pit, between rocks, or somewhere you can't climb out of? Then press U and stand still for three seconds. The snuggle wind will set you down at the nearest safe spot.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.klaar.3: First, go see Grandpa Stardust, right here on the training field. He'll explain the elements to you. You really need to know that before you go on an adventure!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03_poppen.tekst: The training field has training dummies made of hay. Bop them with your left mouse button (your normal attack). Also try your skills on R, V and G, and charge up your ultimate skill on Z.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.0: Aha, the new one! I'm Grandpa Stardust. Do you know the most important thing about bopping? Not how hard. But with WHAT.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.1: Every creature in the Chonkdom has an element. Look at the little icon next to its health bar: a little flame is Fire, a little mushroom is Shroom, a little droplet is Slime, and a little heart is Pink.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.2: And then the triangle, remember it well:  FIRE > SHROOM > SLIME > FIRE.  Fire burns the shroom, the shroom slurps up the slime, and the slime puts out the fire. Pfssst!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.aanbod.3: Bop a creature with what beats it, and you'll see 'Weak!' and do one and a half times as much. The other way around you only do a little. And Pink? Pink is extra strong against everything that's been dechonked. Click on me in a bit, and I'll quiz you!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.bezig: Fire > Shroom > Slime > Fire. Click on me, and I'll quiz you!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.klaar.0: Well done! You're a clever one. Look in your quest log (J) under Guide, the triangle is drawn there once more.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.klaar.1: Now stop by Sergeant Fluffball, on the jetty where you arrived. He has some old stuff for you, and a little lesson in tidying up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq03b_elementen.tekst: Grandpa Stardust teaches you the element triangle: Fire beats Shroom, Shroom beats Slime, and Slime beats Fire. A strong attack does x1.5 and you see 'Weak!'; the other way around only does x0.7. Pink is strong against everything that's been dechonked. The little letter or icon next to a creature's health bar tells you its element. Answer his question!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.aanbod.0: There's my favorite recruit! Will you do something for me? The campfire has gone out, and no fire means no cookies.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.aanbod.1: Right-click a campfire to light it. Then it's your checkpoint: if you ever faint, you'll wake up there again. You don't lose anything, you're just a bit dizzy for a moment.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.bezig: Right-click the campfire, recruit! Then we'll be nice and warm in no time.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.doel.0: Light a campfire in Camp Snuggle
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.klaar.0: Lovely. Sit down for a bit. Look, the sun is rising over the water. Can you see the lights of Shroomsbury in the distance?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.klaar.2: Isn't it? So peaceful. So quiet. So...
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.klaar.3: ...hey. What's that shadow over the water?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq04_kampvuur.tekst: Campfires are your checkpoints: light one with a right-click and that's where you'll wake up if you faint. Light the campfire on the square and sit down with the cook for a bit.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.aanbod.0: Recruit! To the pond! That thing is gigantic!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.bezig: At the pond, recruit! Watch his shadow and jump out of the way! Use R on the little ones!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.doel.0: Cheer up the Gray Blob Giant
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.klaar.0: You cheered him up! Look at him, all pink. He's wagging. Can blobs wag?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.klaar.1: He can stay. From now on he's our Camp Blob. He fits in the pond perfectly.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.klaar.2: But that dragon... what WAS that?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.klaar.3: That... was Wahoognir. Once he was the great pink guardian dragon of the Chonkdom. Wherever he flew, flowers bloomed. Now he's gray, and wherever he flies they wilt. He is the source of the Chonklessness.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.klaar.4: The Grandmaster has to know about this. Captain Cloudwhistle will fly you to Shroomsbury: you'll find him by his airship on the camp's eastern pier. You're not a recruit anymore: you're a real adventurer of The Snuggle Order!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq05_klodderreus.tekst: A big dragon flew over the camp and dropped a clump of black fluff into the pond. Out came a gigantic gray blob! Cheer him up. Watch his shadow: that's where he'll land.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.aanbod.0: There's the hero of the camp! All aboard! My balloon ship flies on warm air and good cheer, and we've both got plenty.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.aanbod.1: Shroomsbury is on an island north of here. Mushrooms as tall as towers, with little houses on their caps. The Order's temple sits right at the very top. Ready?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.bezig: Just say when you want to leave! Pick 'To Shroomsbury' below, or ring the ship's bell on the pier (right-click) and pick Shroomsbury on the travel map.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.doel.1: Report to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.klaar.0: So you're the recruit who cheered up the Blob Giant. Welcome to the temple of The Snuggle Order. I am Grandmaster Chonkfoot.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.klaar.1: Wahoognir... I knew him when he was still pink. He ate cotton candy out of my paw. Something or someone has turned him gray, and now he's spreading the Chonklessness across the whole realm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.klaar.2: Everywhere he flew, there are now gray scars in the land. That's where we have to start. Talk to me again, and I'll tell you where the first scar is.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq06_zwamzoet.tekst: Captain Cloudwhistle flies you by airship to Shroomsbury, the mushroom city. The Grandmaster is waiting in the temple of The Snuggle Order, at the very top of the tallest shroom.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.aanbod.0: East of the city lies the Blob Meadow. The happiest blobs in the realm live there. Lived there. A gray scar runs right through the meadow.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.aanbod.1: Go take a look. Cheer up the blobs that have turned grouchy, and bring back some gray fluff. Professor Fluff will surely want to see it too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.bezig: The scar is in the southeast of the Blob Meadow. Follow the gray trail.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.doel.0: Investigate the scar in the Blob Meadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.doel.1: Cheer up blobs in the Blob Meadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.klaar.0: Gray fluff... As soft as ever, but it feels cold. And look: this bit has a stamp on it. A small round paw.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.klaar.2: Blobs don't have paws. Hm. Hm hm. I need to think about this. In the meantime, go get stronger, adventurer. Come back to me when you're level 6: then I'll send you to the Sporewood.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq07_littekens.tekst: Investigate the gray scar in the Blob Meadow, east of Shroomsbury. Cheer up the blobs that turned grouchy because of it and collect some gray fluff for research.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.aanbod.0: The second scar runs through the Sporewood. Giant mushrooms, beams of light, and shrooms that are in a very bad mood right now.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.aanbod.1: Ranger Moss knows the woods like no one else. Look for him at the campfire on the edge of the forest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.bezig: The Sporewood is west of the city. Ranger Moss is sitting at the first campfire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.doel.0: Investigate the scar in the Sporewood
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.doel.1: Cheer up creatures in the Sporewood
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.klaar.0: Ah, an adventurer of the Order. About time. The shrooms have been grumpy ever since that gray cloud passed over.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.klaar.1: But I did see something. At night, little figures walked through the woods. Small. With sacks. They were heading north, to the Drip Caves.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.klaar.3: I couldn't see them very well. They meowed a bit. Strange, huh?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.klaar.4: Get a bit stronger first, level 12, and then come back to me, here at the campfire on the edge of the woods. Then I'll tell you who might have seen those little figures up close.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq08_sporenwoud.tekst: The second scar runs through the Sporewood, west of the city. Ranger Moss keeps watch there at the first campfire. Cheer up the shrooms along the way.
Miner Giggles works deep in the Drip Caves. If anyone has seen those little figures, it's him.
But I haven't heard from him in days. Find him, and bring him to the campfire by the cave entrance. He always gets lost, the sweetie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.bezig: Giggles is somewhere deep in the Drip Caves. Bring him to the cave campfire!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.doel.1: Cheer up creatures in the Drip Caves
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.doel.2: Bring Miner Giggles to the cave campfire
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.klaar.0: Phew! Light! Air! A campfire! Thank you so much, adventurer.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.klaar.1: Those little figures? Yes! I saw them. They were lugging sacks full of gray fluff through the caves, heading east. Toward the mountain of the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.klaar.2: What kind of creatures were they?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.klaar.3: Small ones. With pointy little ears. And a tail. They were talking about 'the plan' and 'the boss'. That's all I caught, my little helmet was over my ears.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.klaar.4: Go to the Shroom Temple, high on the mountain in the northeast, and look for Temple Guard Stalky by the great door. Cross the Gorge over the dragon fossil bridge. But be careful: the creatures there are strong. Reach level 16 first, that's safer.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.praat.m: Hello? An adventurer! Finally! I'm lost. Again. Will you take me to the campfire? I'll follow right behind you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq09_druipgrotten.tekst: Miner Giggles works in the Drip Caves in the northwest. He might have seen the little figures. Find him deep in the caves and bring him safely to the cave campfire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.aanbod.0: The Shroom Temple is on the mountain in the northeast. You have to cross the Gorge, over the old dragon bones. Brrr.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.aanbod.1: If those little figures are up to something there... then the Order needs to know. You go. I'll stay right here by this nice little fire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.bezig: The Shroom Temple is in the northeast, on the mountain. Over the dragon fossil bridge!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.doel.0: Go to the mountain of the Shroom Temple
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.klaar.0: Halt! Ah, an adventurer of the Order. I am Temple Guard Stalky.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.klaar.1: Something is wrong in the temple. The Overshroom, the ancient keeper of the temple, has turned gray. All his temple shrooms are grouchy. And I heard meowing behind the walls.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.klaar.2: Are you level 18? Then talk to me again, here by the great door. And if you want to go inside: right-click the great door, and it will open. From level 18 that always works.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq10_zwamtempel.tekst: The little figures went to the Shroom Temple, high on the mountain in the northeast. Cross the Gorge over the dragon fossil bridge and report to Temple Guard Stalky by the great door.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.aanbod.0: The Overshroom was once the sweetest shroom in the realm. Now he makes roots shoot out of the ground and blows gray spores around.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.aanbod.1: When the temple goes dark, all you'll see are his glowing eyes. Light the lightshrooms then! Bring friends if you have to. Together is always chonkier.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.bezig: Right-click the great door to open it. The Overshroom is deep inside the temple. Cheer up his temple shrooms first.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.doel.0: Click the great door of the Shroom Temple
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.doel.1: Cheer up creatures in the Shroom Temple
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.klaar.0: You did it! The Overshroom is himself again. He's crying a little. From happiness, I think. Or from the spores.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.klaar.1: And look what fell out of his cap. A little pin. With a cat's face on it. With a nasty little grin.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.klaar.3: Take it to Grandmaster Chonkfoot, in the Order temple at the top of the tallest shroom in Shroomsbury. Take the lift at the foot of that shroom. Hurry!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq11_opperzwam.tekst: Right-click the great door of the Shroom Temple: it will slide open. Go inside, cheer up the temple shrooms and help the Overshroom. Watch out for his spore clouds, and when the temple goes dark: light the lightshrooms!
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.aanbod.0: Off you go, adventurer. The Grandmaster has to see this.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.bezig: To the Grandmaster, quickly! He's in the Order temple on the tallest shroom.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.doel.0: Take the Mika pin to Grandmaster Chonkfoot
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.klaar.0: A Mika pin... So the paw print on the fluff, the little figures with sacks, the meowing in the temple. It was Mikas.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.klaar.1: The Mikas turned Wahoognir gray. They catch his chonk in sacks, and wherever he flies, they leave gray fluff behind. That way the whole realm loses its chonk, and they keep getting stronger.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.klaar.2: But Mikas are crumb thieves, not dragon tamers. So much chonk in sacks... For whom? Who eats that much?
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.klaar.4: Look at the horizon. There, beyond the mountains. He's circling over lands none of us have ever seen.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.klaar.5: Zone one is chonky again, thanks to you. The scars are already getting their color back. But this was only the beginning. Rest up a little, adventurer. The Chonkdom is big.
vadsrijk.npc.q.hq12_schaduw.tekst: Take the Mika pin to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k01_dobber.aanbod.0: Psst. Don't talk too loud, the little slimes are sleeping. My hat blew away. Toward the lighthouse, I think.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k01_dobber.aanbod.1: Could you go and look? I can't leave here. I'm sitting so comfortably.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k01_dobber.bezig: My hat must be somewhere near the lighthouse in the northwest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k01_dobber.doel.0: Find the hat near the lighthouse
vadsrijk.npc.q.k01_dobber.klaar.0: You found it! There was a little snail inside. He can keep living there. Thank you so much!
vadsrijk.npc.q.k01_dobber.tekst: Fisher Bobber has lost his hat. It blew toward the lighthouse.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k02_uitzicht.aanbod.0: A good hunter looks far away first, and only then up close. Take a walk to the lighthouse with the guh ears.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k02_uitzicht.aanbod.1: From there you can see Shroomsbury in the distance. Mushrooms as tall as mountains!
vadsrijk.npc.q.k02_uitzicht.bezig: The lighthouse is in the northwest, on the cliff.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k02_uitzicht.klaar.0: Pretty, huh? That's where you're headed soon. Remember this feeling, adventurer.
vadsrijk.npc.q.k02_uitzicht.tekst: Miss Dart thinks every hunter should first see the view from the lighthouse. From there you can see Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_hoedhupper.aanbod: Hey, you already have a mount! Then you're ready for a Cloud Lamb.
A Cloud Lamb is a little ball of wool that floats a bit. It falls very gently and can jump once more in mid-air. In the Blob Meadow there's a pasture where one sometimes comes to graze.
Bring five root shrooms from the Sporewood. No Cloud Lamb can resist those.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_hoedhupper.bezig: Find the Lamb Meadow in the southeast of the Blob Meadow, and five root shrooms from the Sporewood.
Look who floated after you! It chose you. I can tell by its little curls.
Take good care of it. The more you ride it, the stronger it gets. Press X when you need it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_hoedhupper.tekst: Stable Master Hoofy helps you get your first mount: a Cloud Lamb. Find the Lamb Meadow in the Blob Meadow and collect root shrooms to lure one over.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_hoedhupper.titel: A Cloud Lamb of Your Own
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.aanbo: Hey, you've got a mount! Then maybe you're just the right one for this little story.
By the lightbeams in the Sporewood stand three old lanterns of the Order. When they're lit, a very soft deer sometimes comes to have a look. As soft as a plushie. I call it the Snuggle Deer.
A snuggle deer? Is that really real?
Nobody has ever seen it up close. Light the three lanterns, then follow the glowing little hoofprints. Be quiet, okay? Deer don't like snoring.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.bezig: Three lanterns by the lightbeams in the Sporewood. Then follow the glowing little hoofprints!
Light the lantern by the lightbeam in the southeast of the Sporewood
Light the lantern by the lightbeam in the middle of the Sporewood
Light the lantern by the lightbeam in the northwest of the Sporewood
Follow the glowing little hoofprints to the hidden clearing
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.klaar: The deer walked along with you?! All the way here? Look, it's standing behind you, sniffing!
It only does that with someone it trusts completely. It wants to come with you, adventurer. Take good care of it, and give it a Root Shroom now and then.
vadsrijk.npc.q.rijdier_knuffelhert.tekst: Ranger Moss tells of a very soft deer that sometimes comes to look when the old lanterns by the lightbeams of the Sporewood are lit. Light the three lanterns and follow the glowing little hoofprints to the hidden clearing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.aanb: I can tell by the way you stand: you've become a true Snuggle Knight. But every Snuggle Knight chooses their own path someday.
There are two: Shield Knight and Giant Pillow. Both strong, both different. Master Pillowcase chose one once, too. He never regretted it.
Reach level 17 and then come back here, to the Order temple. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.bezi: Level 17 as a Snuggle Knight, then back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.doel: Reach level 17 as a Snuggle Knight (the Drip Caves and the Gorge help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.klaa: Kneel, adventurer. Well, sort of sit down a bit. It's time to choose.
Take a good look at both paths. Shield Knight or Giant Pillow. Having doubts later? You can switch with the class master in any town. But for now: choose with your heart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_knuffelridder.teks: You've become a true Snuggle Knight. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you'll choose your spec, Shield Knight or Giant Pillow. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
I can tell by the way you stand: you've become a true Fluff Hunter. But every Fluff Hunter chooses their own path someday.
There are two: Sharpshooter and Snare Setter. Both strong, both different. Miss Dart chose one once, too. She never regretted it.
Reach level 17 and then come back here, to the Order temple. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.bezig: Level 17 as a Fluff Hunter, then back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.doel.0: Reach level 17 as a Fluff Hunter (the Drip Caves and the Gorge help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.klaar.0: Kneel, adventurer. Well, sort of sit down a bit. It's time to choose.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.klaar.1: Take a good look at both paths. Sharpshooter or Snare Setter. Having doubts later? You can switch with the class master in any town. But for now: choose with your heart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_pluisjager.tekst: You've become a true Fluff Hunter. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you'll choose your spec, Sharpshooter or Snare Setter. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
I can tell by the way you stand: you've become a true Chonk Mage. But every Chonk Mage chooses their own path someday.
There are two: Star Weaver and Blessing Singer. Both strong, both different. Grandpa Stardust chose one once, too. He never regretted it.
Reach level 17 and then come back here, to the Order temple. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.bezig: Level 17 as a Chonk Mage, then back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot in the Order temple of Shroomsbury.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.doel.0: Reach level 17 as a Chonk Mage (the Drip Caves and the Gorge help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.klaar.0: Kneel, adventurer. Well, sort of sit down a bit. It's time to choose.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.klaar.1: Take a good look at both paths. Star Weaver or Blessing Singer. Having doubts later? You can switch with the class master in any town. But for now: choose with your heart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.spec17_vadsmagier.tekst: You've become a true Chonk Mage. Reach level 17 and come back to Grandmaster Chonkfoot: then you'll choose your spec, Star Weaver or Blessing Singer. After that, you're ready for the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z01_wolletjes.aanbod.0: Come here a moment, chonky. I was knitting on a bench by the meadow, and then a blob came along. Chomp! My ball of wool. And another. And another.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z01_wolletjes.aanbod.1: If you cheer them up, I'm sure they'll spit them back out. Six balls, and then I can finish your scarf.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z01_wolletjes.bezig: Six balls of wool, chonky. The blobs in the Blob Meadow have them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z01_wolletjes.klaar.0: There they are! A little sticky, but that just makes them knit nicely. Here, a cookie. And another. You're far too skinny.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z01_wolletjes.tekst: The grumpy blobs in the Blob Meadow have eaten Granny Trudy's balls of wool. Cheer them up, and they'll spit the wool right back out.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z02_zwamtaart.aanbod.0: Help! Tomorrow is the Shroom Pie Festival and I'm out of little shroom caps!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z02_zwamtaart.aanbod.1: In the Sporewood there are shrooms walking around that lose their caps when you cheer them up. Five of them, and I'll bake the biggest pie ever. You get the first slice!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z02_zwamtaart.bezig: Five little shroom caps from the Sporewood! The oven's already on.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z02_zwamtaart.klaar.0: Perfect! Smell that? That's the smell of success. And of mushroom. Here, a slice of pie for the road.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z02_zwamtaart.tekst: Baker Ben needs little shroom caps for his famous shroom pie. The shrooms in the Sporewood drop them once they're cheerful again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z03_knuffels.aanbod.0: My plushies are gone! All ten! They went on an adventure without me!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z03_knuffels.aanbod.1: They're everywhere. In the camp, in the town, in the meadow, in the woods, in the caves... When you get close, they sparkle. Will you look for them? Pleeeease?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z03_knuffels.bezig: Found them yet? They sparkle with little hearts when you're close!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z03_knuffels.klaar.0: ALL OF THEM! You found every single one! Mr. Fluff, Miss Earsy, Captain Snugs... everyone's here!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z03_knuffels.klaar.1: Here, I found this under my bed. It's shiny. You can have it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z03_knuffels.tekst: Little Kiki's ten plushies have gone 'on an adventure' and are scattered all over the Chonkdom. Find them! They sparkle a little when you're close.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z04_inspiratie.aanbod.0: O adventurer, O brave chonk! I have a problem. A poet's problem. My inspiration has run dry.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z04_inspiratie.aanbod.1: There are rock spires in the realm with a gorgeous view: the Blob Lookout, the Shroom Spire and the Harbor Tooth. Climb them and tell me what you see!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z04_inspiratie.bezig: The Blob Lookout in the meadow, the Shroom Spire in the woods, the Harbor Tooth by the harbor. Look closely!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z04_inspiratie.klaar.0: I saw the whole meadow full of blobs, a forest full of lightbeams and the sea with a turtle island in the distance.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z04_inspiratie.klaar.1: A turtle island... in the distance... Oh! Oh! 'Out where the turtle sleeps at sea, Shroomsbury softly dreams with me.' WAHOOG! Thank you!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z04_inspiratie.tekst: Poet Percy needs inspiration. Visit three lookout points (the rock spires) and tell him what you saw.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z05_post.aanbod.0: Mail! Mail! Too much mail! My bag is so heavy I'm walking crooked.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z05_post.aanbod.1: Will you deliver three for me? Granny Trudy by the square, Smith Hammerhead at his smithy and Harbormaster Anchor at the harbor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z05_post.bezig: Granny Trudy, the smith and the harbormaster. Go go!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z05_post.klaar.0: All delivered? Super! Now I can walk straight again. Here, a little tip.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z05_post.praat.havenmeest: Mail! A postcard from my sister in the faraway south. 'Greetings from the sunshine.' How sweet.
A letter from my grandchild! Look, with a drawing of a blob. Or a cloud. Lovely either way.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z05_post.praat.smid.0: A letter for me? 'Dear smith, my sword has turned pink.' Yep, swords do that here. Thanks!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z05_post.tekst: Postguh Pete has too many letters. Deliver three of them: to Granny Trudy, Smith Hammerhead and Harbormaster Anchor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z06_tulpen.aanbod.0: My tulips! Look at them! Gray! They were always as pink as a guh's nose!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z06_tulpen.aanbod.1: It's because of that scar in the meadow, I just know it. If the blobs there are cheerful again, maybe my flowers will get their color back.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z06_tulpen.bezig: Cheer up ten blobs in the Blob Meadow. Meanwhile, I'll sing to my tulips.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z06_tulpen.klaar.0: Look! The first petal is already turning pink! Thank you, thank you, thank you. Here, a little bouquet for you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z06_tulpen.tekst: Ever since the dragon flew over, Gardener Tilly's tulips have been gray. Inspect the scar in the Blob Meadow and cheer up ten blobs: maybe it'll help.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z07_tuba.aanbod.0: Oom-pah... oom... no. It just doesn't work without a tuba.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z07_tuba.aanbod.1: I was having a picnic in the Sporewood, way down in the southwest. And then a spore puffer showed up. I ran away. My tuba didn't.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z07_tuba.bezig: My tuba is deep in the Sporewood, in the southwest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z07_tuba.doel.0: Find the tuba in the Sporewood
vadsrijk.npc.q.z07_tuba.klaar.0: MY TUBA! There's a mushroom inside. Oom-pah-pah-POOF! Haha, now it sounds even better!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z07_tuba.tekst: Musician Mo left his tuba behind at a picnic deep in the Sporewood, by the waterfall in the southwest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.aanbod.0: Ah! An adventurer! Just what I need. I'm researching the Chonklessness, scientifically!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.aanbod.1: Bring me eight tufts of gray fluff. From any dechonked creature, doesn't matter which. Careful: it makes you sneeze.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.bezig: Eight tufts of gray fluff! Any dechonked creature can drop it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.klaar.0: Fascinating! Look through my magnifying glass. See those tiny stamps? Pawprints. Pawprints everywhere.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.klaar.1: Who would stamp pawprints on fluff? Scientifically speaking: someone with paws.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.klaar.2: And look: all the pawprints go the same way. Away from us. All of them. Scientifically speaking, very suspicious.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z08_pluis.tekst: Professor Fluff wants to study gray fluff. Unchonked creatures sometimes drop it when you cheer them up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z09_kristal.aanbod.0: New hypothesis! Droplet Crystals from the Drip Caves are very pure. Maybe they can turn gray fluff pink again!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z09_kristal.aanbod.1: Somewhere deep in the caves there's a hidden crystal chamber. Find it, and bring me three Droplet Crystals.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z09_kristal.bezig: The crystal chamber is in the farthest corner of the Drip Caves. And three Droplet Crystals!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z09_kristal.klaar.0: Look! Fluff plus crystal makes... PINK FLUFF! It works! This'll be my fourth diploma!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z09_kristal.tekst: Professor Fluff thinks Droplet Crystals can purify the gray fluff. There's a hidden crystal chamber in the Drip Caves.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z10_rammel.aanbod.0: You there! Young adventurer! In my day I walked to the Blob Meadow every single day. Now they say I'm 'too old'.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z10_rammel.aanbod.1: Take me with you! One last time to the campfire in the meadow. I'll walk right behind you. Rattle rattle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z10_rammel.bezig: Rattle rattle! I'm right behind you, off to the campfire in the meadow!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z10_rammel.doel.0: Bring Sir Rattle to the campfire in the meadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.z10_rammel.klaar.0: There it is! The old campfire. I sat right here, a hundred years ago. It still smells exactly the same.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z10_rammel.klaar.1: Thank you, young chonk. Here, my old medal. I'll walk back by myself. Slowly. Very slowly.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z10_rammel.tekst: Sir Rattle is retired, but wants to visit the Blob Meadow one last time. Bring him safely to the first campfire in the meadow.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z11_slijmgel.aanbod.0: Darling, I'm out of gel. And no gel means no curls, and no curls means no customers.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z11_slijmgel.aanbod.1: The best stuff comes from the blobs in the Blob Meadow. Six drops, fresh please.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z11_slijmgel.bezig: Six slime drops, darling. Fresh from the Blob Meadow.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z11_slijmgel.klaar.0: Mmm, these smell like strawberry. Have a seat. Done! Your little ears look fabulous.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z11_slijmgel.tekst: Stylist Blowdry makes hair gel from fresh blob slime. Cheerful blobs sometimes drop a drop.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z12_kleuren.aanbod.0: I wanted to paint the Blob Meadow, but everything's gray! Gray, gray, gray! I've only got one tube of gray.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z12_kleuren.aanbod.1: Cheer up fifteen of them, and they'll get their color back. Pink, blue, yellow... then I can paint again!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z12_kleuren.bezig: Cheer up fifteen blobs. I'm sitting here ready with my brush.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z12_kleuren.klaar.0: COLORS! Colors everywhere! This will be my masterpiece. I'll call it 'Adventurer with Blobs'. You're in it!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z12_kleuren.tekst: Painter Penny wants to paint the Blob Meadow again, but all the blobs are gray. Cheer up fifteen of them, and they'll get their color back.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z12_kleuren.titel: All the Colors of the Meadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.z13_snurk.aanbod.0: Zzz... huh? Oh. Hi. Sorry. I haven't slept in three nights.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z13_snurk.aanbod.1: Every night: SNOOOORE. From the Blob Meadow. It must be one of those big elite blobs with a glow around it. Can you cheer it up? Happy blobs snore softer.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z13_snurk.bezig: An elite blob in the meadow. You can tell them by their glow and their big name. Zzz...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z13_snurk.doel.0: Cheer up an elite creature in the Blob Meadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.z13_snurk.klaar.0: It's quiet! Wonderfully quiet! I'm going straight to bed. Here, take this, zzz...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z13_snurk.tekst: Sleepyhead Sam can't sleep: every night something in the Blob Meadow snores really loudly. It must be an elite blob. Cheer up an elite.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z14_kistjes.aanbod.0: Disaster! Drama! My little cart rolled down the slope in the Drip Caves. Four little chests, gone!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z14_kistjes.aanbod.1: The cave creatures must have taken them. Cheer them up and see if they drop anything. I pay well! Well, fairly well.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z14_kistjes.bezig: Four little chests from the Drip Caves! My best stuff is in them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z14_kistjes.klaar.0: My little chests! Everything in one piece? Yes! Here's your reward. And a discount, forever. Ten percent. On nothing. Just kidding!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z14_kistjes.tekst: Trader Ted's little cart tipped over in the Drip Caves. Four little chests are missing, and the cave creatures found them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.aanbod.0: Ever since the dragon came over, the sky has been grayish. I measure it every day. Grayishness: seven. Too high!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.aanbod.1: Campfires help. Once one is burning in every area again, the sky gets chonkier all by itself. Meteorologically proven!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.bezig: A campfire in the meadow, the woods and the caves. There's a knight guh at every fire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.doel.0: A campfire in the Blob Meadow
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.doel.2: A campfire in the Drip Caves
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.klaar.0: Grayishness... two! Look, the clouds are already turning pink. You're a hero, and a weather scientist!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.klaar.1: Strange, though: I'm also measuring grayishness from a direction the dragon never flies. My meter says 'very far away'. It's probably exaggerating.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z15_lichtjes.tekst: Weatherguh Cloudy wants the realm to glow again. Light a campfire in the Blob Meadow, the Sporewood and the Drip Caves.
I'm Tip! We're playing hide-and-seek! For two days now! I can't find Tap. She's really good.
She always hides by mushrooms. So... in the Sporewood? Can you look? I'll keep counting. One, two, three...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z16_verstoppertje.bezig: ...a hundred forty-four, a hundred forty-five... Found her yet?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z16_verstoppertje.klaar.0: You found her! She says she won. I say she didn't. Here, for your trouble!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z16_verstoppertje.praat.t: Hee hee! Found me! Tell Tip I won. I'll stay a little longer, my mushroom is so snug.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z16_verstoppertje.tekst: Tip is playing hide-and-seek with his twin sister Tap, but he hasn't been able to find her for two days. She's somewhere in the Sporewood.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z17_koning.aanbod.0: Hear that rumbling? That's King Blob, in his arena in the middle of the meadow. As big as a house. With an attic.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z17_koning.aanbod.1: He splits into three little colors, and you have to cheer them up at the same time. And when he jumps, the whole meadow turns into a shadow. Find a safe spot then! Bring friends.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z17_koning.bezig: King Blob is in his arena in the Blob Meadow. The board by the door tells you when he's awake.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z17_koning.klaar.0: You cheered up the king! I could hear him giggling all the way over here. Here, you've earned a reward from the Guard.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z17_koning.tekst: King Blob lives in the Blob Meadow, the biggest blob in the realm. He's gray and grumpy. Cheer him up, preferably with friends.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z18_premie_woud.aanbod.0: Bounty! Stamped and approved. Cheer up twenty-five creatures in the Sporewood. Just sign here.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z18_premie_woud.aanbod.2: Here. And here. And here. Done! A little stamp on it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z18_premie_woud.bezig: Twenty-five in the Sporewood. I've got your stamp card ready.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z18_premie_woud.doel.0: Cheer up creatures in the Sporewood
vadsrijk.npc.q.z18_premie_woud.klaar.0: Twenty-five! Stamp, stamp, stamp... Here you go, your bounty. Stamped.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z18_premie_woud.tekst: The quest board: a bounty for whoever cheers up twenty-five creatures in the Sporewood.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z19_premie_grotten.aanbod: New bounty! The Drip Caves. Twenty-five creatures. Wet feet guaranteed. Sign here.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z19_premie_grotten.bezig: Twenty-five in the Drip Caves. Bring a little towel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z19_premie_grotten.doel.0: Cheer up creatures in the Drip Caves
Dripping wet, but done! Stamp. Bounty. Here you go.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z19_premie_grotten.tekst: The quest board: a bounty for whoever cheers up twenty-five creatures in the Drip Caves.
The toughest bounty on the board: the Shroom Temple. Twenty-five temple creatures. I'm stamping with a trembling paw.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z20_premie_tempel.bezig: Twenty-five in the Shroom Temple. Watch out for the spore priests!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z20_premie_tempel.doel.0: Cheer up creatures in the Shroom Temple
vadsrijk.npc.q.z20_premie_tempel.klaar.0: You're a legend. I'm stamping your card with my GOLDEN stamp. I almost never use that one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z20_premie_tempel.tekst: The quest board: a bounty for whoever cheers up twenty-five creatures in the Shroom Temple.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_knuffelridder.aa: You already bear two titles of the Order. But up in the mountains, a third awaits: Crystal Champion.
Reach level 30 and defeat twenty creatures in the Splinter Gorge. Then I'll hold the biggest ceremony right here, in the smallest chapel in the realm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_knuffelridder.be: Level 30 as a Snuggle Knight, and twenty creatures in the Splinter Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_knuffelridder.do: Reach level 30 as a Snuggle Knight (fight on the Echo Slopes, by the lake and in the gorge)
Defeat 20 creatures in the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_knuffelridder.kl: The crystals sing, the hot cocoa steams. I hereby name you Crystal Champion! Grandmaster Chonkfoot will be proud.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_knuffelridder.te: The third title of the Snuggle Order: Crystal Champion. Reach level 30 as a Snuggle Knight and prove yourself in the Splinter Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_pluisjager.aanbo: You already bear two titles of the Order. But up in the mountains, a third awaits: Polestar Falcon.
Reach level 30 and defeat twenty creatures in the Splinter Gorge. Then I'll hold the biggest ceremony right here, in the smallest chapel in the realm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_pluisjager.bezig: Level 30 as a Fluff Hunter, and twenty creatures in the Splinter Gorge.
Reach level 30 as a Fluff Hunter (fight on the Echo Slopes, by the lake and in the gorge)
Defeat 20 creatures in the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_pluisjager.klaar: The crystals sing, the hot cocoa steams. I hereby name you Polestar Falcon! Grandmaster Chonkfoot will be proud.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_pluisjager.tekst: The third title of the Snuggle Order: Polestar Falcon. Reach level 30 as a Fluff Hunter and prove yourself in the Splinter Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_vadsmagier.aanbo: You already bear two titles of the Order. But up in the mountains, a third awaits: Crystal Oracle.
Reach level 30 and defeat twenty creatures in the Splinter Gorge. Then I'll hold the biggest ceremony right here, in the smallest chapel in the realm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_vadsmagier.bezig: Level 30 as a Chonk Mage, and twenty creatures in the Splinter Gorge.
Reach level 30 as a Chonk Mage (fight on the Echo Slopes, by the lake and in the gorge)
Defeat 20 creatures in the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_vadsmagier.klaar: The crystals sing, the hot cocoa steams. I hereby name you Crystal Oracle! Grandmaster Chonkfoot will be proud.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_adv30_vadsmagier.tekst: The third title of the Snuggle Order: Crystal Oracle. Reach level 30 as a Chonk Mage and prove yourself in the Splinter Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.bez: Five drill tracks, and then the hidden drill hall at the bottom of the gorge, all the way in the west.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.doe: Find the five drill tracks (purple sparkles: in the Splinter Gorge, on the Echo Slopes and in Sugarbowl)
Defeat the Mika Drill Master in the hidden drill hall at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, all the way in the west
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.kla: The Drill Master! Defeated! Fled home in a puff of smoke, you say? With his little helmet crooked?
So THAT was the rumbling. A drilling machine with three heads, deep in the mountain. They were drilling for the gray crystal. For the splinters of the heart, I think.
You're the smartest sleuth in the mountains. Here, a cogwheel from his machine. I had it gilded. With candy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_geheim_boormeester.tek: All over the Splinter Peaks lie traces of an enormous Mika machine. Find all five: then you'll know where it stands, and how to make its three drill heads overheat.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.aa: Adventurer! Have you heard? The dragon has been spotted above the crystal spires in the north. The Splinter Peaks.
There's a little town up there, Sugarbowl, inside a giant geode of pink quartz. Warm on the inside, freezing cold outside. I've just started flying there.
A little. There's ice on the route. And snowstorms. And... well. Just hop in, you'll see for yourself. Put your scarf on!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.be: Hop in with me, here in the Harbor, and fly to Sugarbowl. Café Owner Mallow is waiting there with hot cocoa.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.do: Fly with Pilotguh Zeppy from the Harbor to Sugarbowl
Talk to Café Owner Mallow in the cocoa café on the southeast side of Sugarbowl's square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.kl: There you are! Frozen solid! What a flight, huh? I saw the airship glide in with an icicle on its nose.
Here, a mug of hot cocoa. With whipped cream. With marshmallows. Drink it slowly, it's hot.
There was a wolf standing on a crystal spire. It howled, and then the spire cracked...
An Echo Wolf. Brrr. The mayor needs to know about this. Go see the mayor on the north side of the square, and then report to Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard, by the quest board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq01_splinterpieken.te: Grandmaster Chonkfoot saw Wahoognir circling above the crystal spires in the north. Pilotguh Zeppy in the Harbor has a new airship line: to Sugarbowl, the warm little town in the Splinter Peaks. Fly along and talk to Café Owner Mallow there.
Finish your cocoa first. There. And now: off to the mayor. He knows everything about the mountains.
The mayor stands on the north side of the square, in front of the big snowguh spruce. After that, Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard, by the quest board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.bezig: The mayor on the north side of the square, and then Captain Quartz by the quest board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.doel.0: Talk to Mayor Candy on the north side of Sugarbowl's square, in front of the big snowguh spruce
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.doel.1: Report to Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard, by the quest board on Sugarbowl's square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.klaar.0: So. You're the Order's adventurer. The mayor sent a note. With little hearts. He always overdoes it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.klaar.1: Listen. Lately the crystal spires on the Echo Slopes have been singing off-key. Creatures are turning gray and hard as stone. Splinterlings, we call them. And yesterday an Echo Wolf howled.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.klaar.2: The Crystal Guard holds the gates. But we can't go outside. You can. Start at the Echo Slopes, in the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.praat.z: Welcome, welcome! To Sugarbowl, the warmest spot in the coldest mountains! I'm Mayor Candy.
Our geode keeps the cold out. But not the worries. Guhs have been petrified by the lake. Gray crystal, from head to toe. They're still alive, mind you. They just can't move anymore.
By the Chonklessness, they say. Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard knows more. He's by the quest board, on the northeast side of the square.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq02_kandijkom.tekst: Sugarbowl lies safe inside its pink geode, but outside, the Chonklessness is growing stronger: creatures are turning into gray crystal. Talk to Mayor Candy on the square and report to Captain Quartz of the Crystal Guard.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.aan: The Echo Slopes. Leave the geode through the East Gate, at the end of the street past the Candy Stall, and follow the path up. Mountain Guide Climbpaw sits by the first campfire.
Light that fire: that's where you'll wake up if things go wrong. And watch out for the Splinterlings. They shoot shards when you hit them.
No cheer-up poof here, adventurer. These are real monsters. Gray crystal without a heart. When you defeat them, they burst into shards that melt away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.bez: Out of the geode through the East Gate (the street past the Candy Stall), up the path, to Mountain Guide Climbpaw's campfire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.doe: Light the campfire by Mountain Guide Climbpaw: through Sugarbowl's East Gate, then up the path to the western edge of the Echo Slopes
Talk to Mountain Guide Climbpaw by that campfire
Defeat 12 creatures on the Echo Slopes, east of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.kla: Twelve! Good work. The slope is already a little quieter. Only the spires are still singing off-key.
You know, those spires are always singing. But lately they sound... angry. I think there's something in the shards.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.pra: An adventurer! Lovely. I'm Climbpaw, mountain guide. I know every stone around here. And every snow hare by name.
See those gray creatures between the spires? Splinterlings and Sleet Spirits. They used to be ordinary little snow critters. Defeat a dozen or so, then we can take a closer look.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq03_galmhellingen.tek: East of Sugarbowl lie the Echo Slopes: snowfields with crystal spires that sing back when you hit them. Light Mountain Guide Climbpaw's campfire, talk to him and defeat the crystal creatures roaming there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.aanbod.0: When you defeat a Splinterling, sometimes a shard is left behind that hums. An Echo Shard. Bring me six.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.aanbod.1: And then climb up to the Echo Spire. The big one, in the east, above the Echo Wolf's den. It cracked when the Echo Wolf howled on it. See what you find there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.bezig: Six Echo Shards, and a look at the cracked Echo Spire in the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.doel.0: Collect 6 Echo Shards from the creatures on the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.doel.1: Climb to the cracked Echo Spire above the Echo Wolf's den, in the east of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.klaar.0: Let me see... Hm. Hear that? They're all humming the same little tune. Low. Gray. Like a growl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.klaar.1: There were pawprints by the spire. Really big ones. And the snow was gray.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.klaar.2: The Echo Wolf. He howls the Chonklessness into the mountains, and the spires sing it back. As long as he howls, everything turns to stone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq04_naalden.tekst: Mountain Guide Climbpaw wants to know why the crystal spires are singing off-key. Collect Echo Shards from the creatures on the Echo Slopes and climb to the cracked Echo Spire, where the Echo Wolf howled.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.aanbod.0: There's only one way to make the spires sing clear again. The Echo Wolf has to be silenced.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.aanbod.1: His den is in the east of the slope. When he howls, a crystal wave rolls over the snow. Hide behind a frozen pillar! But those pillars break, one by one. Be quick.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.aanbod.2: Bring friends if you can. I'll wait here with warm tea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.bezig: The Echo Wolf's den is in the east of the Echo Slopes. Hide behind the pillars when he howls!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.doel.0: Defeat the Echo Wolf in his den in the east of the Echo Slopes (hide behind the frozen pillars when he howls)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.klaar.0: You defeated the Echo Wolf! I could hear it all the way over here: the whole mountain sighed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.klaar.1: The spires are singing clear again. Well, almost. The Crystal Guard owes you its thanks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.klaar.2: But there's more. By the Frozen Snuggle Lake, in the west, guhs have been petrified. Real guhs. Will you go take a look?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq05_galmwolf.tekst: The Echo Wolf is howling the Chonklessness into the Echo Slopes. Defeat him in his den at the top of the slope. When he howls, crystal waves roll over the snow: hide behind the frozen pillars. But watch out, they break one by one. Then head back to Captain Quartz in Sugarbowl.
The Frozen Snuggle Lake is in the west. Leave the geode heading west. Ice Fisher Holey sits there, right in the middle of the ice.
Four guhs have been petrified there. They're still alive. They're just stuck in the crystal.
How do I get them out?
Not with your weapon! Never. Ask Holey. He saw it happen.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.bezig: The lake is in the west. First Ice Fisher Holey, then the four petrified guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.0: Talk to Ice Fisher Holey on the little island in the middle of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.1: Free Skater Swirl: click the gray crystal in the middle of the lake's ice
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.2: Free Fisher Pike: click the gray crystal by the ice floes in the south of the lake
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.3: Free Plushmaker Pip: click the gray crystal on the west side of the ice
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.doel.4: Free Little Icy: click the gray crystal on the little island in the middle of the lake, next to Holey
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.klaar.0: All four free! Swirl is swirling again, Pike is fishing again, Pip is knitting again and Icy ran home.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.klaar.1: You know what's strange? When the crystal came, the ice creaked. And under the ice, something moved. Lots of little things. And something big.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.praat.z: The tiniest statue of them all. You give the gray crystal a hug. A really big one.
Krrrk... krak... FLOMP! The crystal falls off like powdered sugar.
Hee hee! That tickled! Are you a knight? You smell like hot cocoa.
The crystal around Pip is thick and gray. You press your little ears against it and hum a song. The crystal hums back... and pops into pieces.
My plushies... I was knitting plushies for the children of Sugarbowl. They slid under the ice when the crystal came. Thank you, sweetie.
You knock softly on the crystal and think of something happy. The crystal starts to glow pink, and then... CRACK!
...A bite! A BITE! Oh. No. I'm just awake. How long have I been standing here?
You lay your little paw on the gray crystal. It's cold. Then you feel something beating, very softly. You think of something nice: hot cocoa, a hug, a campfire...
KRRRACK! The crystal cracks and falls off him like gray snow. He blinks his eyes.
...Oopsie. Hey! I can move again! Was I... a statue? A handsome statue, I hope?
Pssst. Quietly. The ice is thin over there. And the creatures are awake.
I saw it happen. A gray wind blew across the lake, and wherever it passed, guhs went still. Gray. Hard. Like crystal.
Crystal remembers what you feel. Lay your little paw on it and think of something nice. Then it cracks. I already tried, but I thought of fish. That didn't work.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq06_versteend.tekst: At the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl, four guhs have been petrified into gray crystal. Talk to Ice Fisher Holey by his ice hole and free the four guhs: lay your little paw on the crystal and think of something nice. You never hurt guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.aan: Those big things under the ice... they come up when you hit hard. The ice cracks then. Watch where you stand!
Defeat them, and check the big crack in the north. Ice Sculptor Chisel sits on the north shore. He sees everything, he stares at ice all day long.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.bez: Defeat the creatures around the lake, inspect the crack in the north and talk to Chisel on the north shore.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.doe: Defeat 15 creatures around the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
Defeat an elite at the Frozen Snuggle Lake (a big creature with a glowing name)
Inspect the big crack in the ice, in the north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake
Talk to Ice Sculptor Chisel by his ice sculptures on the north shore of the lake
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.kla: Tap. Tap. Oh, hello. You've been to the crack? Then you've seen the drag marks.
I saw them walking at night. Little figures with pointy ears and little helmets. With sleds full of gray crystal. They were pulling them north, toward the Splinter Gorge.
Mikas? The cheese ones? Well, they did meow. And they sang a song about drilling. Very off-key.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq07_onder_het_ijs.tek: Something is moving under the ice of the Snuggle Lake. Defeat the ice creatures around the lake, and a strong elite, and inspect the big crack in the north of the ice. Ice Sculptor Chisel, on the north shore, saw something.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.aan: The gorge is in the north. Leave the geode heading north and follow the path up. Gorge Keeper Ropey stands by the middle rope bridge.
Bring back a few drill bits as proof. Then they'll believe you in Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.bez: The Splinter Gorge is in the north. First Gorge Keeper Ropey by the middle rope bridge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.doe: Talk to Gorge Keeper Ropey by the middle rope bridge of the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl
Defeat 12 creatures or Mika Miners in the Splinter Gorge (defeated Mikas flee home in a puff of smoke)
Take 3 Mika Drill Bits from the Mika Miners in the Splinter Gorge
Find the big Mika Drill Tower in the east of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.kla: Three drill bits. With little Mika pawprints on them. And you saw the big tower?
They're drilling the gray crystal out of the mountains. Sacks full of it.
So that's the rumbling. For weeks now. But there's something else, adventurer. Something I didn't dare tell anyone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.pra: Hi! Don't be scared if the bridge wobbles. It always does that. I'm Ropey.
Mikas? Oh yes. Everywhere. With little helmets and drills and lunchboxes. When you defeat them, they vanish in a puff of smoke. Then they run back to their fort, somewhere far away.
Their biggest drill tower is in the east of the gorge. You can hear it from a mile away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq08_splinterkloof.tek: The drag marks lead to the Splinter Gorge, north of Sugarbowl: steep walls, wobbly rope bridges and Mika drill rigs harvesting crystal. Talk to Gorge Keeper Ropey, chase off the Mika Miners and find the big drill tower.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.aanbod.0: Three nights ago something fell onto the mountain pass in the west, above the lake. Something big. It didn't rumble. It... sighed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.aanbod.1: I don't dare look. Do you? Go carefully. And no bonking, please. Look first.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.bezig: The mountain pass in the west, above the lake. Slowly, and look first!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.doel.0: Go to the mountain pass north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake, on the southwest edge of the Splinter Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.doel.1: Help whatever is lying on the mountain pass
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.0: Was it... was it really the dragon? Wahoognir? And you HELPED him?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.1: There was a gray crystal splinter stuck in his wing. I pulled it out. He looked at me. For a long, long time. And then he flew away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.2: I thought he was the enemy. The source of all the grayness. But he was hurting... Maybe it's all different from what we think.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.klaar.3: That splinter... Lightkeeper Prism at the Mirror Keep knows everything about crystal. Take it there. The keep stands on the highest peak, in the northeast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq09_draak.tekst: Gorge Keeper Ropey saw something big crash onto the mountain pass north of the Frozen Snuggle Lake. Something that breathes. Go carefully and see what it is.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.aan: Follow the gorge north, across this middle rope bridge, and then up the stairs. Way, way up. You'll see the keep sparkling.
Bring a warm scarf. And your courage.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.bez: Across the middle rope bridge to the north, and then up the stairs to the Mirror Keep.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.doe: Climb to the gate of the Mirror Keep, on the highest peak in the northeast
Talk to Lightkeeper Prism at the gate of the Mirror Keep
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.kla: A Gray Dragon Splinter... Let me see. Look, when I hold it up to the light, you can see a teeny pink dot. Deep inside.
This is no ordinary crystal. This comes from a heart. From his heart. The pink heart crystal of Wahoognir.
His heart broke into pieces. That's how the Chonklessness began. And a big piece of it... is in there. With Lady Mirrorsigh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.pra: Halt, traveler. You stand before the Mirror Keep. Once the brightest palace in the realm. Now...
...gray. I'm Prism. I guard the last little bit of light here.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq10_spiegelburcht.tek: The Mirror Keep stands on the highest peak in the northeast, beyond the Splinter Gorge: a palace of gray crystal full of mirrors. Climb to the gate and talk to Lightkeeper Prism.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.aanb: Lady Mirrorsigh used to admire herself all day long. Harmless. Vain, but harmless.
When the heart crystal broke, a splinter fell into her mirrors. Now she sees only gray, and she wants everyone to see gray.
Bounce the light to each door, and you'll get through. And in the fight: watch the shadows! The reflection without a shadow is the real one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.bezi: Through the mirror halls to the back, to the Hall of Mirrors. Only hit the reflection without a shadow!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.doel: Defeat 10 mirror creatures in the halls of the Mirror Keep
Defeat Lady Mirrorsigh in the Hall of Mirrors at the back of the keep (only hit the reflection without a shadow)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.klaa: You did it. The mirrors are clear again. And look... what's in your little paws.
The splinter of the heart crystal. Pink. Warm. It's beating. Take a good look into it...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq11_spiegelzucht.teks: In the Hall of Mirrors at the back of the Mirror Keep sits Lady Mirrorsigh, turned gray by the splinter of the heart crystal. Go through the mirror halls to the back: bounce the light from mirror to mirror to open the doors. In the fight she splits into reflections: you can only hit the one without a shadow, and the light shifts each phase.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.aanb: Go, adventurer. The Order must know about this.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.bezi: To Order Master Crystalline in the Crystal Chapel on the north side of Sugarbowl (behind the big snowguh spruce).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.doel: Bring the pink heart splinter to Order Master Crystalline in the Crystal Chapel on the north side of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.klaa: A splinter of the heart crystal... I've only read about them. In the oldest books of the Order.
There was also a picture of a cat with a little crown, and gray mist creeping across the whole page. That page has been torn out. Not by me.
Back when Wahoognir was still pink, he carried a heart of pink crystal. As long as it was whole, he protected the entire realm.
Someone broke it. The Mikas? They're drilling the gray crystal out of the mountains... they're looking for something.
Then we'll look for the other splinters. Before the Mikas find them.
Look to the east. See that, far, far away, behind the clouds? A tree. As big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_hq12_hartsplinter.teks: You've found the first splinter of Wahoognir's pink heart crystal. Bring it to Order Master Crystalline, in the Crystal Chapel on the north side of Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.aanbod: Psst. You've got a mount, right? Then you'll understand this. Hear that? At night, something howls in the Splinter Gorge.
A little snow wolf! As small as a cushion, all alone at the bottom of the gorge. I can't climb, I knit.
Lovely! Bring it back here. I'll start knitting a little scarf. A very little scarf. For now.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.bezig: The little wolf is at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, at the foot of the second staircase. Bring it here safely!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.doel.0: Find the howling little wolf at the bottom of the Splinter Gorge, at the foot of the second staircase down
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.doel.1: Cheer up 5 grumpy creatures in the Splinter Gorge, so the little wolf can come along safely
There he is! Come here, little one. Here, your little scarf. It looks gorgeous on you.
A few days, lots and lots of hot cocoa and three little scarves later...
Look how big he's gotten! He doesn't fit in your hood anymore. But he still wants to come with you. On his back, even!
Here, his scarf saddle. Take good care of each other, you two. And drop by now and then for a new scarf.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_rijdier_guhwolf.tekst: Knitter Woolwinter hears something howling in the Splinter Gorge at night: a little snow wolf, all alone. Find it at the bottom of the gorge, cheer up the grumpy creatures around it and bring it safely to Sugarbowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.aanbod.0: My plushies went skating on the lake. Without me! And then... crack. Now they're stuck under the ice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.aanbod.1: They're all over the lake, under the ice. They sparkle with little hearts. Will you free them? Pleeeease?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.bezig: They sparkle with little hearts under the ice of the lake in the west!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.doel.0: Free the 10 plushies under the ice (on the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.klaar.0: ALL OF THEM! Snowball, Polar Cubby, Captain Quartzy, Mitty... everyone's back!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.klaar.1: Here, I found this in the snow. It's shiny. You can have it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s03_knuffels.tekst: Little Flake's plushies (knitted by Plushmaker Pip) slid under the ice. They're stuck under the ice of the Frozen Snuggle Lake. They sparkle with little hearts: walk up close, and you'll carefully break them free.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.aanbod.0: New in Sugarbowl? Then you have to skate! Everyone skates here. Even the mayor. Mostly on his tummy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.aanbod.1: Go on, step onto the ice. Paws apart. Little arms wide. And... WHEEE!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.bezig: On the ice of the pond, in the middle of the square. Paws apart!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.doel.0: Stand on the ice of the skating pond, in the middle of Sugarbowl's square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.klaar.0: Beautiful! You only fell three times. That's a record for an adventurer. Here, a diploma. It's a cookie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s04_schaatsen.tekst: Skate Coach Twirly gives every new adventurer a skating lesson. Stand on the ice of the skating pond and come back without falling. Well. Without falling much.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.aanbod.0: Do, re, miiii... Hear that? Nothing. The spires used to sing along. Now they're too shy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.aanbod.1: Will you go visit them? The low one, the middle one and the high one. On the Echo Slopes. Just sing a little. Or hum. Or just go 'laaa'.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.bezig: Do, re, mi: three spires on the Echo Slopes, from low to high.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.doel.0: Sing at the low spire (do), in the south of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.doel.1: Sing at the middle spire (re), in the middle of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.doel.2: Sing at the high spire (mi), in the north of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.klaar.0: I heard them! All the way over here! Do... re... MIIII! The Candy Choir is complete again. With the echo, there are three of us!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s05_echokoor.tekst: Chorister Echo wants to sing with the crystal spires again. Visit the three singing spires on the Echo Slopes (do, re, mi): when you stand close, they sing their note.
My secret ingredient is all gone! Crushed ice flower. It crackles on the whipped cream. Delicious.
Out by the lake, the creatures sometimes have them stuck in their fur. Five, please!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.bezig: Five ice flowers from the creatures at the lake in the west.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.doel.0: Collect 5 ice flowers from the creatures at the Frozen Snuggle Lake, west of Sugarbowl
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.klaar.0: Smell that. That's the smell of the best cocoa in the realm. Here, a mug for the road. And another one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s13_ijsbloemen.tekst: Café Owner Mallow always sprinkles crushed ice flower over the whipped cream. The creatures at the Frozen Snuggle Lake drop them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.aanbod.0: Have you been up top yet? No? Then you haven't seen the mountains! Hop in.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.aanbod.1: Say hi to my brother Pulley. He's up at the top. He can never hear me down the cable.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.bezig: Hop in the gondola with me, and say hi to Pulley up top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.doel.0: Take the gondola at Gondolaguh Cable (northeast side of Sugarbowl) to the top station
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.doel.1: Say hi to Gondolaguh Pulley at the top gondola station, high in the north of the Echo Slopes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.klaar.0: Pulley says hi back? Through you? Finally, a conversation! Thank you, adventurer.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.praat.z2_go: Greetings from Cable? Tell him: 'Hi Cable! Can you hear me now?' Haha. He never hears a thing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z2_s23_gondel.tekst: Gondolaguh Cable thinks everyone should ride the gondola to the top at least once. Take the gondola and say hi to Gondolaguh Pulley up top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.aa: You swept the Mikas' yard clean, and your Plumeguh already knows the tree better than I do. I've seen it.
Anyone who gets this far deserves the second title of the Order. Reach level 35 as a Snuggle Knight, and the beekeepers will dance in the Nest Chapel. For you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.be: Level 35 as a Snuggle Knight, then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.do: Reach level 35 as a Snuggle Knight (the Canopy Sea, the yard and the bounties help)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.kl: The bees buzz, the blossoms fall, the beekeepers dance. Your spec grows along with the tree!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv35_knuffelridder.te: Your second title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 35 as a Snuggle Knight and come back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel: then your spec grows stronger.

vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv50_knuffelridder.aa: You already wear three titles. But deep in the tree, a fourth one awaits: Nest Warden.
Reach level 50 and defeat twenty-five creatures in the Rootdark. Then the beekeepers will dance in the Nest Chapel. For you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv50_knuffelridder.be: Level 50 as a Snuggle Knight, and twenty-five creatures in the Rootdark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv50_knuffelridder.do: Reach level 50 as a Snuggle Knight (bounties, the Heart of the Tree and the Rootdark help)
Defeat 25 creatures in the Rootdark, under the tree
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv50_knuffelridder.kl: The bees buzz, the blossoms fall, the beekeepers dance. I name you Nest Warden! The whole tree is proud of you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv50_knuffelridder.te: The fourth title of the Snuggle Order: Nest Warden. Reach class level 50 as a Snuggle Knight and prove yourself in the Rootdark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv50_pluisjager.aanbo: You already wear three titles. But deep in the tree, a fourth one awaits: Canopy Falcon.
Reach level 50 and defeat twenty-five creatures in the Rootdark. Then the beekeepers will dance in the Nest Chapel. For you.

Defeat 25 creatures in the Rootdark, under the tree

vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_adv50_pluisjager.tekst: The fourth title of the Snuggle Order: Canopy Falcon. Reach class level 50 as a Fluff Hunter and prove yourself in the Rootdark.

Defeat 25 creatures in the Rootdark, under the tree
