vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.bezig: Five clues, and then the secret hatch in the Comb Clusters.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.doel.0: Find the five clues of the strange beekeeper in Honeybough (purple sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.doel.1: Defeat the Mika Beekeeper in his secret comb hall, behind the hatch in the Comb Clusters
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.klaar.0: A Mika! In a beekeeper suit! And the queen bee is golden again, you say? Then she'll start singing again!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.klaar.1: So THAT beekeeper suit on the clothesline was his. I knew it. Well, I thought it was weird. That's almost knowing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.klaar.2: Here, a little honeycomb from the queen herself. She sends her thanks. With a buzz.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_geheim_imker.tekst: All over Honeybough there are clues of a strange beekeeper: broken smoke pots, gray honey, a beekeeper suit on the clothesline. Find all five, and you'll know where he's hiding.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.aanbod.0: Adventurer! Crystalline told me. A tree, she says. In the east. As big as a mountain.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.aanbod.1: I've been flying there since this morning. Halfway up the trunk, a little town hangs around it like a ring: Honeybough. Full of beekeepers and bees.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.aanbod.3: Yep. Don't look down. Hop in, it's a long flight. And it goes up. Very, very up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.bezig: Board the airship to Honeybough. Beemother Combsy is waiting on Blossom Square.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.doel.0: Fly with Captain Polaris from Sugarbowl to Honeybough (pick Honeybough at the airship pier)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.doel.1: Talk to Beemother Combsy on Blossom Square, on the south side of Honeybough's ring deck (walk from the mast along Beekeepers' Lane and the ring deck around the trunk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.0: There you are, sweetie! What a flight, huh? Everyone always looks so amazed the first time they see the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.1: I'm Combsy. Mayor, beekeeper and everybody's granny around here. Welcome to Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.2: In the roots... I saw two eyes. Grayish blue. And I heard something creak.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.klaar.3: Eyes? In the roots? Brrr. Order Master Waxie needs to hear this. She's in the Nest Chapel, the big honeycomb cell under the north side of the ring deck. Take the chapel lift down.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.tekst: Order Master Crystalline saw it in the east: a tree as big as a mountain. Captain Polaris in Sugarbowl flies there now: to Honeybough, a beekeepers' town that hangs like a ring around that tree's trunk. Beemother Combsy is waiting there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq01_boom.titel: A Tree as Big as a Mountain
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.aanbod.0: An adventurer of the Order! Welcome to the Nest Chapel. See that empty egg pedestal over there? Nobody remembers what it's for.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.aanbod.1: But I have a hunch. This tree... the branches, the feathers in the canopy... I think this was once Wahoognir's nest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.aanbod.3: Shh. Do you hear that? A propeller. That's no bee. That's... a ZEPPELIN! Up, quick, to the square!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.bezig: The Leaf Bandits on Blossom Square! And then check on Beemother Combsy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.doel.0: Defeat 8 Leaf Bandits dropped by the Mika zeppelin on Honeybough's Blossom Square (chapel lift up, then along the ring deck to the south side)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.doel.1: Check that Beemother Combsy on Blossom Square is all right
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.0: Everyone's safe. The guhs were all in their hive houses with the little shutters closed. Nobody got hurt.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.1: But look what the zeppelin dropped. A leaflet. 'Operation Ripe Cheese. By order of Baron Bleu, on behalf of His Poshness Count Squeakula.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.3: A count? Mikas with titles? That's new. And not good news.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.4: What you need now is a mount. This tree is too big to walk. Stable Master Feathers has her Plume Stable down on the ground, on the north side, where the riding path begins.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.klaar.5: Take the lift in the trunk's inner courtyard (through the stair door here on the square) down to the floor of Barkton, and go out through the north gate. And here: the key to the Honey Lift. With it you can always get back up fast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq02_bezoek.tekst: Order Master Waxie of the Nest Chapel thinks this tree was once Wahoognir's nest. But then a Mika zeppelin buzzes over the market. Defeat the Leaf Bandits it drops on Blossom Square.
A knight without a mount in a tree this size? You'd be walking until next spring.
Look, there in the stall. Three young Plumeguhs. Pink, mint and lavender. Long legs, fluffy little body, a plume tail.
Wait a minute... big yellow birds you ride on... that rings a bell...
No, it is NOT some choco-whatsit from some Fantasy game. This is a Plumeguh. Just look at the little ears, nyeg!
Go ahead and blow the Stable Whistle. All three will come running and show you what they can do. Pick one. Then we'll ride up the riding path together. I lead, you follow.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.bezig: Pick your Plumeguh, follow Feathers up the riding path to the top of canopy 1, and glide down from the glide platform.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.0: Pick your own Plumeguh with Stable Master Feathers in the Plume Stable (on the ground on the north side of the tree)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.1: Call your Plumeguh (key X) and climb on, at the Plume Stable
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.2: Follow Stable Master Feathers up the riding path: around the trunk, past Blossom Square and through the leaf tunnel to the top of canopy 1
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.doel.3: Ride to the glide platform on the south edge of canopy 1, jump off and glide down (hold jump)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.klaar.0: Did you see that? You and your Plumeguh, through the air! Your first Plume Glide!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.klaar.1: You can always glide from up high. Only downward, mind you. Going up is for the riding path, the stairs, the lifts and the blossom wind.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.klaar.2: Did you see those gray patches in the canopy? Those are from the zeppelins. Canopy Warden Leaf needs help. He's at his campfire on the east side of canopy 1.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq03_pluimstal.tekst: Stable Master Feathers has three young Plumeguhs. Pick one, give it a name, and take your first ride: Feathers rides ahead of you up the riding path, round and round the trunk, to the top of canopy 1. Jump off the glide platform there: your first Plume Glide.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.aanbod.0: Canopy Warden Leaf guards the Canopy Sea. He's at his campfire on the east side of canopy 1, not far from the Mika Zeppelin Pier.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.aanbod.1: Clean up the gray patches on the way. You only have to ride past them: your Plumeguh shakes blossoms out of its plume. Really. That's what it was bred for. You get to canopy 2 with the pink wind column.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.bezig: Three gray patches, twelve creatures, and a peek at the zeppelin pier. Then on to Canopy Warden Leaf.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.0: Clean up the first gray patch, on the southeast side of canopy 1
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.1: Clean up the second gray patch, on canopy 2 on the southwest side (up the wind column)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.2: Clean up the third gray patch, on the north side of canopy 1
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.3: Defeat 12 creatures in the Canopy Sea
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.doel.4: Search the Mika Zeppelin Pier on the northeast edge of canopy 1 for their plans
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.0: You cleaned up the canopy! The leaves are already turning green again. What did you find at the pier?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.1: An order. 'Find the egg. Let it ripen. Bring it to the Count. The Count brings it to Him.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.2: Him? With a capital letter? Who's that, then?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.klaar.4: An egg... All the way at the top of the tree, above canopy 3, there's an old nest. Enormous. I never dare go near it. You do, I think.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq04_vlekken.tekst: Mika zeppelins have sprayed the Canopy Sea gray. Ride past the three gray patches on canopy 1 and canopy 2 and clean them up, defeat the creatures in the canopy and check the Mika Zeppelin Pier to see what they're up to. Canopy Warden Leaf is waiting at his campfire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.aanbod.0: See those pink columns with swirling blossoms? Those are wind columns. Step in and you float up to the next canopy. Three times, and you're at the nest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.aanbod.1: Watch out for the Canopy Raptor. It sits on the Bald Crown, the dead treetop on the west side of canopy 1. Just leave it alone if you don't want a fight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.bezig: To the old nest at the top of the tree. Then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.doel.0: Go to the old nest at the top of the tree: the pink wind columns blow you from canopy 1 to canopy 2 and 3 (or take the inner stairs all the way up)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.doel.2: Find the glowing pink thing among the branches of the nest
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.0: A heart splinter. Pink, warm... just like the splinter you found in the Splinter Peaks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.1: He came back here. Wounded. He left a piece of his heart with his egg.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.2: And there were drag marks to the edge. And tiny wooden footprints.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.klaar.3: Wooden feet? Then it wasn't the Mikas. Someone carried that egg away long ago. I need to think. And so does Combsy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq05_nest.tekst: All the way at the top of the tree, above the three canopy levels, lies a gigantic old nest. Go there and see what's left of it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.aanbod.0: Combsy is the oldest in town. If anyone knows something about the tree folk, it's her.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.aanbod.1: And do you hear that? Something's been squeaking in the Comb Clusters all morning. Could you take a look?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.bezig: First Beemother Combsy, and then that squeaking in the Comb Clusters.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.doel.0: Ask Beemother Combsy on Blossom Square about the tree folk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.doel.1: Find out what's squeaking in the Comb Clusters, the honeycomb cell under the east side of the ring deck (take the Comb Cluster lift down)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.0: A squeaky-squeak mousie! Totally bald! And so cold... come here, little one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.1: All he said was 'the Count... the cold...'. He comes from somewhere below us. From the dark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.2: Below us? The tree folk used to live in the trunk. Their old map is with Mapmaker Loopy, in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village, on the Bee Bough in the southeast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.klaar.3: Take the mousie with you. It won't come out of your bag anymore. I think it trusts you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.praat.z3_: Wooden feet? Oh, the tree folk. My granny used to tell me about them. Little wooden critters with lights in their heads.
They built a city in the trunk, she said. With lanterns, along a staircase that went all the way up to the nest. Then it went quiet, and the lanterns went out.
They had a map of the whole trunk. Loopy has it now, in Buzzrest. I think. I hope.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq06_voetjes.tekst: The little wooden footprints in the nest belong to the tree folk, the old residents of the trunk. Ask Beemother Combsy what she knows. And something is squeaking in the Comb Clusters.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.aanbod.0: The riding path runs past the foot of every giant bough. Where a bough begins, you can ride right onto it. Buzzrest is on the Bee Bough, in the southeast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.aanbod.1: Don't be scared on the boughs. Anywhere you can fall, you can glide. And your Plumeguh is very good at not-falling.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.bezig: To Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village on the Bee Bough, help Loopy, and clear out the three Cheese Shooter Posts.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.0: Ride to Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village: up the riding path to just above Honeybough, and onto the Bee Bough on the southeast side
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.1: Talk to Mapmaker Loopy in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.2: Clear out the first Cheese Shooter Post, on the West Bough
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.3: Clear out the second Cheese Shooter Post, on the North Bough on the east side of the tree
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.4: Clear out the third Cheese Shooter Post, on the Southwest Bough
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.doel.5: Defeat 12 creatures or Mikas on the Branchways
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.klaar.0: The posts are gone! And my tea is warm again. Well, lukewarm. It's a start.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.klaar.1: The Tree Folk Map... the Mikas took it. To their yard. The Cheese Zeppelin Yard, on the island in the northeast. You get there over the cable bridge, from the northeast edge of Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.klaar.2: I saw them go. With the map in a cheese crate. Laughing the whole way. Very rude.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.praat.z3: A visitor! Careful, the bough wobbles. I'm Loopy. I draw maps. Of everything. Even of things that spin around.
The Tree Folk Map? Oh dear... The Mikas came by. Nobody got hurt, don't worry. But my tea went cold from the fright.
They built three Cheese Shooter Posts on the boughs. Help the village first, will you? Then I'll tell you everything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq07_hangnest.tekst: Mapmaker Loopy lives in Buzzrest Beekeepers' Village, on the Bee Bough in the southeast. Ride up the riding path and onto the bough, and help the village: Mika Cheese Shooters have built three posts on the giant boughs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.aanbod.0: The cable bridge starts at the northeast edge of Honeybough. You can already see the cranes from here. And smell the cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.aanbod.1: Go with friends if you can. Three Mika bosses, on three docks, each one higher than the last. Even for a hero with a Plumeguh, that's a lot.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.bezig: The Cheese Zeppelin Yard: over the cable bridge, three docks, three bosses, and then the captain's cabin.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.0: Defeat Rigging Master Taleggio at Dock 1, on the ground of the yard (over the cable bridge from Honeybough)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.1: Defeat Bombardier Crumble on Dock 2, on top of the scaffold tower (turn the cannons!)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.2: Defeat Captain Roquefort on Dock 3, on top of the tall mast tower
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.doel.3: Search Captain Roquefort's cabin on Dock 3
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.0: You've got the map! And what's that... a little box with a bow on it?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.1: 'For the Count, for his collection.' There was a heart splinter inside. And a letter from Baron Bleu.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.2: Will you read it out loud?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.3: 'My mold turns the egg gray. A gray dragon, all our own. He will be pleased, Your Poshness. Finally one thing He finds full.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.klaar.4: ...Full? Who never finds anything full? Brrr. Look, the map. Inside the trunk runs a staircase, from the ground all the way to the nest. The door is on Blossom Square. And halfway down Barkton, someone drew a little light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq08_werf.tekst: The Cheese Zeppelin Yard lies on its own island in the northeast: a Mika Shipyard with three docks, each with a half-built cheese zeppelin. Cross the cable bridge, defeat Rigging Master Taleggio, Bombardier Crumble and Captain Roquefort, and search the captain's cabin for the Tree Folk Map.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.aanbod.0: See that door in the trunk, on the square? I always thought it was a broom closet. According to the map, it's a staircase.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.aanbod.1: Halfway down there's a little drawing of a light. With a little face. It's winking. Weird, for a map.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.bezig: Through the stair door on Blossom Square, down the inner stairs, and then find the little light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.doel.0: Go through the stair door in the trunk wall on Honeybough's Blossom Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.doel.1: Go down the inner stairs and find the little light in a little house in the trunk wall, halfway down Barkton
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.klaar.0: ...You can see me. Nobody has seen me in so long. I'm Knot. The last little light of the tree folk.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.klaar.1: The lanterns have been out ever since the Count moved in under our floor. He likes the dark. And the cold. That makes the little furs fall out faster.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.klaar.3: Look, there. The Lantern Tower, in the middle of the trunk. Seven rings. Once they burn again, he'll have nowhere left to hide.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq09_spiraal.tekst: The Tree Folk Map shows the way in: the stair door on Blossom Square. Behind it, the inner stairs spiral down through the hollow trunk, past the tree folk's little houses in the wall: Barkton. Halfway down, the map shows a little light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.0: See the tower? It stands in the middle of the trunk, from the floor up to Honeybough's inner courtyard. Seven rings. Seven lanterns.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.1: On every ring, the Count has put little mice in a cage. In the cold. Until their little fur falls out. For his cape.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.3: Light the ring lanterns from the stairs. Then the little locks will spring open. Halfway, I'll give you something, because under the floor it's pitch dark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.aanbod.4: And under the floor... that's where he sits. Count Squeakula. The Emperor's Little Finger. The stairs to his Fur Hall start on the floor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.bezig: Seven rings, from bottom to top. And then down the stairs to the Fur Hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.0: Light the 7 rings of the Lantern Tower, from bottom to top (stand on the inner stairs next to each ring lantern)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.1: Defeat Count Squeakula in the Fur Hall, under the floor of Barkton (break the cage locks, relight the lanterns)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.2: See what happens in the Fur Hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.doel.3: Pick up the cape pin, by the throne in the Fur Hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.0: ...The lanterns. All of them. The whole trunk is glowing again. I haven't seen it like this since... I don't even remember anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.1: That fog... I know it from old stories. It is his grabby power. It reaches far. Always farther. He takes everything that is warm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.2: I'll tell you what happened to the egg. The tree folk carried it down when the dragon turned gray. The heart of the tree would keep it warm until he was himself again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.3: We went to sleep in the wood. The egg stayed awake.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.klaar.4: Go to Order Master Waxie. Tell her everything. The lift in the inner courtyard takes you straight up to Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq10_piepvel.tekst: In the middle of Barkton stands the Lantern Tower. Light the seven rings, from bottom to top: on every ring, little mice sit in a cage. Under the floor of Barkton, in the Fur Hall, sits Count Squeakula, the Emperor's Little Finger, in a cape made of mouse furs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.aanbod.0: An emperor. The Mikas have an emperor. Then this is bigger than a dragon, knight. Much bigger.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.aanbod.1: But first: the egg. It lies in the heart of the tree, under the trunk. And down there, the roots are rotting.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.aanbod.2: Take the Honey Lift to Mossfoot. Mayor Rootina knows more. And the little mice you freed can smell mold from a mile away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.bezig: Take the Honey Lift to Mossfoot, see Mayor Rootina, and then shut off the two mold kettles.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.doel.0: Talk to Mayor Rootina in Mossfoot (take the Honey Lift down, in the southeast of Honeybough)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.doel.1: Shut off the first mold kettle of the Mika Mold Farm, in the west of the Root Fields
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.doel.2: Shut off the second mold kettle, also at the Mika Mold Farm
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.klaar.0: The kettles are off! Can you smell that? It smells like sap again. And moss. And a little bit like maple syrup.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.klaar.1: I can already see the field getting its colors back. Green, pink, and the water turquoise again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.klaar.2: There's one more thing. Under the tree, in the Rootdark, the veins are glowing pink. Brighter and brighter. As if something lives down there. The Root Gate is on the east side, on the ground.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.praat.z3_w: A hero with a Plumeguh! And with... little mice? They're all squeaking at once. They want to go somewhere.
The Mikas put two mold kettles in the Root Fields. Both at their mold farm, on the west side of the tree. That's why everything is rotting.
Just follow the little mice. They stand at every entrance and squeak the way. You don't have to search for anything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq11_wortel.tekst: In Mossfoot, the hamlet at the foot of the tree, the roots are rotting away: the Mikas put mold kettles in the Root Fields. Talk to Mayor Rootina and shut off the two kettles. The freed little mice squeak the way.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.aanbod.0: The Root Gate is on the east side of the tree, on the ground. Behind it, a tunnel goes down. After that it's dark. Really dark.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.aanbod.1: Stay in the light of your lantern. In the dark the monsters hurt less, but you can barely see them either.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.aanbod.2: Root Guard Glow is at the campfire in the Heartbeat Hall. He knows how to get into the Heart.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.bezig: Through the Root Gate, follow the pink veins to the Heartbeat Hall, and light the four cave lanterns.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.doel.0: Go to the Root Gate, on the ground on the east side of the tree
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.doel.1: Follow the pink veins down through the Root Tunnel to the Heartbeat Hall, the root hall under the trunk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.doel.2: Light the 4 cave lanterns around the gate of the Heart, in the west wall of the hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.klaar.0: You lit the lanterns! Look, the gate of the Heart is opening. Do you hear that beat?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.klaar.1: And something else is beating. Softer. Faster. There, in the middle of the hall, in that basket of roots.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.klaar.2: ...I've never heard that before. A second heart. A tiny little heart. But the guardians of the Heart won't let you near it. Go, adventurer. Through the gate, all the way around the ring of halls.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq12_duister.tekst: Under the tree lies a big root hall: the Rootdark. With your Nest Lantern, follow the pink veins through the Root Tunnel to the Heartbeat Hall, and light the four cave lanterns by the gate of the Heart, on the far side of the hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.aanbod.0: The Heart is a dungeon. Beating walls, mold curtains, and three guardians, all the way around the ring. Go with friends if you can.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.aanbod.1: The Root Strangler is a tangle of gray roots. Cut through its feeding roots when the heart beats.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.aanbod.2: And the Old Nest Warden... he isn't bad. Just gray. Cheer him up, and he'll let you through.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.bezig: The Heart of the Tree: the Root Strangler, the Old Nest Warden, Baron Bleu. And then the egg, in the middle of the hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.0: Defeat the Root Strangler in the Heart of the Tree (cut through the 4 feeding roots)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.1: Cheer up the Old Nest Warden (stand on the pink tree ring)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.2: Defeat Baron Bleu and his Mold Colossus (fight in the light of the lampposts)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.doel.3: Take the Dragon Egg from the root basket, in the middle of the root hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.0: You've got it. The egg. Look how it glows when you hold it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.1: I kept this warm for him. The little heart of his heart. You already have that splinter. Now all that's left is HIM.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.2: The ground starts to shake. Softly at first. Then harder. Somewhere high above you, the whole tree creaks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.klaar.3: He's coming. He can feel that the egg is awake. Go! Out of the Root Tunnel, up the riding path, back to the old nest! Hurry!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq13_hart.tekst: Behind the gate in the west wall, the Heart of the Tree runs like a ring of halls around the root hall. Defeat the Root Strangler, cheer up the Old Nest Warden and defeat Baron Bleu and his Mold Colossus. Then you can reach the Dragon Egg, in the middle of the hall.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.bezig: To the old nest at the top of the tree. Cheer up Wahoognir. And then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.doel.0: Escape: out of the Root Tunnel, up the riding path around the trunk and up the wind columns, to the old nest
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.doel.1: Cheer up Wahoognir at the old nest at the top of the tree (stand in the pink circle under his chest)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.doel.2: See what happens to the egg
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.0: You're back! And... what's that on your shoulder? Is that... a little dragon?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.1: The baby dragon sneezes. A little pink cloud puffs out.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.2: A pink little dragon. In my chapel. I'm going to sit down. No, I'll stay standing. I don't know anymore.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.klaar.3: Everyone saw it: the pink beam across the whole sky. To the east. Come, knight. Combsy wants to see you too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq14_vahoegnir.tekst: Wahoognir is coming for his egg. Escape from the roots and ride up the riding path, up the wind columns, to the old nest at the top of the tree. Put the egg back and cheer up the Chonkless Dragon: at 75, 50 and 25 percent, put a heart splinter back into his chest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.aanbod.0: Highchonk. The Floating City of the High Council. They know more about emperors than we do.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.aanbod.1: They want to see you, knight. You and that little one. But first say goodbye to Combsy. She baked cake. Three of them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.bezig: Say goodbye to Combsy, and then back to Order Master Waxie in the Nest Chapel.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.doel.0: Say goodbye to Beemother Combsy, on Honeybough's Blossom Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.0: Look at you, with Combsy. And Squeaky, with a fluffy new coat of fur. And that little dragon who eats everything that's honey.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.1: Go to the edge of Blossom Square, knight. Look to the east. Where the beam ended.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.2: There's a city floating there. Above the clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.klaar.3: Highchonk. Soon an airship will fly there. Until then: get some rest. You've earned it. Dragonfriend.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.praat.z3: There's our hero! With a little dragon! Come here, let me cuddle you both. Careful, he sneezes.
Honeybough will never forget you. There's always a little bed for you here. And cake. Three cakes.
Off you go to Waxie. She's been staring east all day.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_hq15_hoogvads.tekst: The dragon is pink again and the egg has hatched. His pink beam pointed east, to Highchonk, the Floating City. Say goodbye to Beemother Combsy and go back to Order Master Waxie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.aanbod.0: Help! My Plume Chicks are gone! They chased after a butterfly. All six of them. Into the Canopy Sea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.aanbod.1: They're stuck by the honey ponds on canopy 1, around the trunk. You'll know them by their pink fluff. And the peeping.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.bezig: Six Plume Chicks, somewhere by the honey ponds in the canopy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.doel.0: Find 6 lost Plume Chicks by the honey ponds on canopy 1 (pink fluff)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.klaar.0: They're all here! One, two, three, four, five... six! Thank you! Here, a bag of Honey Bites for your Plumeguh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s01_kuikens.tekst: Chick Keeper Peep has lost six Plume Chicks in the Canopy Sea. They're hiding by the honey ponds on canopy 1, in pink fluff. Find them all.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.aanbod.0: I used to climb the inner stairs up to the nest every day. To hear the dragon sing. Very softly.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.aanbod.1: Will you take me up one more time? I walk slowly, but I walk. And the monsters don't bother an old guh like me.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.bezig: Grandpa Bark is walking with you to the old nest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.doel.0: Bring Grandpa Bark to the old nest at the top of the tree (he walks with you; creatures leave him alone)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.klaar.0: Look at that. The nest. Just like old times. Do you hear that? No? Me neither. But I still remember how it sounded.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.klaar.1: Thank you, lad. Or lass. Or guh. My eyes aren't what they used to be. My heart still is.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.tekst: Grandpa Bark wants to see the old nest at the top of the tree one more time, like in the old days. He can't walk very well anymore. Take him along.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s02_opa_bast.titel: One Last Time to the Top
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.aanbod.0: Quack! Swamp flowers, that's what I need. Three. For the tastiest tea in the tree.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.aanbod.1: The creatures in the Root Fields often walk around with them. On their heads. Just ask them. With your sword.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.bezig: Three swamp flowers from the Root Fields.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.doel.0: Collect 3 swamp flowers from the creatures in the Root Fields
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.klaar.0: Quack quack! Here, have a taste. And look at your little paws. See how eager they are to go?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s03_thee.tekst: Teaguh Quack in Mossfoot brews honey tea with swamp flowers. It gives you speedy little paws. Pick three swamp flowers in the Root Fields (the creatures in the swamp sometimes drop them).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.aanbod.0: ...Some of my friends are still asleep in the wood. Four. I can feel them. High and low.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.aanbod.1: Will you wake them up? One little light on its own is just a lamp. Together, we're a city.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.bezig: Four sleeping little lights along the inner stairs, above Honeybough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.doel.0: Find 4 sleeping tree folk lights along the inner stairs, just above Honeybough (green glow)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.klaar.0: ...They're awake. Can you hear them? They're laughing. I'd forgotten how that sounded. Thank you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s04_lichtjes.tekst: Along the inner stairs, above Honeybough, four little lights of the tree folk are still asleep. Find them at different heights and wake them up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.aanbod.0: I draw maps, but I never go anywhere. I don't like heights. Weird, for someone who lives on a bough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.aanbod.1: Five lookout points. Stand on each one and take a good look. Then I'll draw them in.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.bezig: Five lookout points: The Crown, Bough's End, the riding path, the Root Vault and the mast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.0: Stand on The Crown lookout, on canopy 2 on the southeast side
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.1: Stand on the Bough's End lookout, at the end of the West Bough
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.2: Stand on the first balcony of the riding path, on the west side of the trunk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.3: Stand on top of the Root Vault, the big ruin in the north of the Root Fields
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.doel.4: Climb into the crow's nest of Honeybough's airship mast
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.klaar.0: All five! Look, my map is finished. With a little drawing of you on it. On a Plumeguh. Very tiny.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z3_s05_kaartjes.tekst: Mapmaker Loopy wants to put five lookout points on her new map. But somebody has to have actually stood there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq01_lampionkust.aanbo: Knight! Dragonfriend! A letter came this morning. With a lantern stamp on it. From Lanternhaven, on the coast in the east.
Every year, when the lanterns light up, plushies wash ashore there. From all over the world. They call it the Great Snuggletide.
Plushies washing ashore? That sounds... actually really sweet.
It is. Normally. But Harbormaster Anchor writes: 'This year they're gray. And sad. Can the Order help?'
Gray... that smells like Mikas. Fly over there. And take a good look at the sky above the sea. You'll see why.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq01_lampionkust.bezig: Fly to Lanternhaven and report to Harbormaster Anchor on the quay.
Fly to Lanternhaven: take the airship from the Tree (Captain Buzzsail, or the travel map: pick The Lantern Coast)
Report to Harbormaster Anchor on the quay of Lanternhaven, at the middle pier by the harbor inlet
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq01_lampionkust.klaar: There you are! A real knight of the Order! Welcome to Lanternhaven, the pink tip of the world.
Look, up there, above the sea. That city on that cloud... that's no cloud. That's Mother Cloudwhale. And on her back: Highchonk.
A city. On a whale. That flies.
You get used to it. After ten years or so. But listen: the plushies. They're lying on Snuggletide Beach, southeast of here.
Foster Mom Softie takes them in. And not just plushies. Guhs are coming from the east too. Skinny, quiet, gray. Will you go help?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq01_lampionkust.tekst: Order Master Waxie got a letter from Lanternhaven, the harbor town on The Lantern Coast. Every year, plushies from all over the world wash ashore there: the Great Snuggletide. But this year they're gray. Fly from the Tree to Lanternhaven and report to Harbormaster Anchor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq02_knuffeltij.aanbod: Snuggletide Beach is on a little island. You can't walk there, and swimming is cold. You need a boat.
Boatguh Saily at the north pier has one for you. With little ears on the sail. Really.
Sail to the beach and help Softie. She's at the rescue center. And be nice to the plushies. They're so gray.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq02_knuffeltij.bezig: Get your sailboat from Boatguh Saily, sail to Snuggletide Beach and cheer up six plushies for Foster Mom Softie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq02_knuffeltij.doel.0: Get your very own guh sailboat from Boatguh Saily at the north pier of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq02_knuffeltij.doel.1: Sail your sailboat to Snuggletide Beach, the island southeast of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq02_knuffeltij.doel.2: Talk to Washguh Sudsy at the plushie laundry next to the rescue center on Snuggletide Beach
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq02_knuffeltij.doel.3: Cheer up 6 gray plushies along the tideline of Snuggletide Beach (walk up to the gray fluffballs in the surf)
Six plushies, and all six a little pink again. Look how they're looking at you.
But they told me things... about a gray land. Carts. Sacks. A Bowl. It gives me chills.
They come from the east. They all said so.
There are four more big plushies on the other little islands. On Beach Party Island, Flower Island, Coral Bay and... on the turtle.
Go get them and listen to their stories. After that, Grandpa Lightbeam in the lighthouse will surely know where they're drifting from. He knows the sea.
Oh, a knight! Right on time. Look over there, along the tideline. Gray plushies. They've been washing ashore all week.
Normally they're cheerful and colorful. In the wash, and pink again in no time. But these... they don't even want you to pick them up. They're shivering.
Just sit down next to them. Say something sweet. Then they'll tell you their story. There are six of them here, in the surf.
After that, Foster Mom Softie wants to see you, at the rescue center. She keeps track of everything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq02_knuffeltij.tekst: Gray, sad plushies are lying in the surf on Snuggletide Beach. First get your own sailboat from Boatguh Saily, sail to the beach and ask Washguh Sudsy what's going on. Cheer up six plushies along the tideline and report to Foster Mom Softie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq03_waarvandaan.aanbo: Four big plushies. Too big for the surf here: they got stuck at the other little islands.
Sail around in your boat. On Beach Party Island, Flower Island, Coral Bay and on the back of the giant turtle.
Big plushies have big stories. Listen closely. And afterwards, go see Grandpa Lightbeam, in the lighthouse in the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq03_waarvandaan.bezig: Four big plushies on four little islands, and then on to Grandpa Lightbeam in the lighthouse.
Cheer up the big plushie lying half in the surf on the south coast of Beach Party Island
Cheer up the big plushie on the west coast of Flower Island, in the middle of the island chain
Cheer up the big plushie on the south ring of Coral Bay, by the opening of the atoll
Cheer up the big plushie on the back of Granny Bobber, the sleeping giant turtle east of Flower Island
Talk to Grandpa Lightbeam in the little house under the big lighthouse on Lighthouse Island, in the east
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq03_waarvandaan.klaar: Come in, come in. I saw your boat from up top. Round and round, from island to island.
The big plushies... they saw a gray city, a long road, a fleet and a throne. Everything went east.
Hmm. Do you know what I see from my tower? All the plushies drift in from the same corner. From the southeast.
From the Gray Fog Bank. No boat gets through there. Not for years. And yet... lately boats HAVE been coming out. With guhs in them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq03_waarvandaan.tekst: Four big plushies have washed up on other little islands. Sail over, cheer them up and listen to their stories. After that, Grandpa Lightbeam in the lighthouse wants to see you: he knows where the current brings them from.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.aanbod.0: Mystery Island lies on the edge of the fog. There's an old gate there. Gray. Nobody knows who built it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.aanbod.1: My light doesn't reach that far. The fog swallows it up. Bring your own light, knight. In your heart, I mean.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.aanbod.2: And after that: back to Softie. She's worried. I can tell from her soup. It's too salty when she's worried.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.bezig: To the gray gate on Mystery Island, talk to Lost Misty, and then back to Foster Mom Softie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.doel.0: Sail to Mystery Island in the fog in the southeast and walk to the crumbling gray gate
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.doel.1: Look through the gray gate, into the fog
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.doel.2: Talk to Lost Misty at the gray gate on Mystery Island
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.doel.3: Bring the news to Foster Mom Softie at the rescue center on Snuggletide Beach
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.klaar.0: A fleet full of plushies... and a Mika with rings on her toes. Poor plushies. Poor guhs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.klaar.1: But wait, there's something else. Something bad. This morning there were eight pink plushies on the drying line. Now there are six.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.klaar.3: Someone saw a kite. A big gray kite with a Mika hanging from it. It flew north, to that old wreck by Coral Bay.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.praat.z4_nev: ...You're not a Mika. Phew. For a moment I thought... Sorry. Everything still makes me jump.
I come from the east. Through the fog. On a raft of plushies, believe it or not. They kept me afloat.
Out there, gray ships are sailing. The Gray Fleet. Full of everything that's warm: plushies, lanterns, songs in little boxes.
They're led by a Mika with rings on all her toes. They call her the Ring Finger. She counts everything. Twice.
When there's a storm, some things fall overboard. Those are your plushies. It's the only way out. By sea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq04_mist.tekst: All the plushies drift in from the southeast, from the Gray Fog Bank. On the edge of the fog lies Mystery Island. Sail there and take a look at the crumbling gate. A guh who came through the fog is said to live there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05_vliegervanger.aan: Two plushies stolen. From my clothesline! They weren't even dry yet.
The wreck lies on a little rock north of Coral Bay. An old Mika ship with a torn kite in the mast.
Be careful. But be a little bit angry too. That's allowed, when someone steals plushies.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05_vliegervanger.bez: To the Wreck of the Kite Catcher, defeat Pinkie and bring the two plushies back to Softie.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05_vliegervanger.doe: Sail to the Wreck of the Kite Catcher, the stranded Mika kite ship on a little rock north of Coral Bay
Defeat Pinkie the Kite Catcher in the hold of the wreck (down the hatch on the deck)
Take back the 2 stolen plushies from the hold of the wreck
Bring the plushies back to Foster Mom Softie on Snuggletide Beach
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05_vliegervanger.kla: Peep! Woolly! There you are! Come here, you dry much better when you're not stuck in a Mika sack.
Pinkie said he wanted to fly them east. For a bonus from the Ring Finger.
That name again. I never want to hear it again. You know what we're going to do now? Something no Mika understands.
A party. The big welcome-home party. Twelve plushies, all pink again. And the guhs from the east get a new home.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq05_vliegervanger.tek: A Mika hanging from a big gray war kite stole two pink plushies from the drying line. He's hiding in the Wreck of the Kite Catcher, a stranded Mika kite ship north of Coral Bay. Get the plushies back.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.aanbod.0: A party needs three things: light, something in the sky and something yummy. That's what it says in my party book.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.aanbod.1: Lanterns from Glowwick in Lanternhaven. Kites from Pennant on Kite Island. And lemonade from Bubbles on Beach Party Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.aanbod.2: Then come back to the beach. Everyone will be there. The plushies too. Especially the plushies.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.bezig: Fetch lanterns, kites and lemonade, then party on Snuggletide Beach.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.doel.0: Get party lanterns from Lanternmaker Glowwick in the lantern workshop of Lanternhaven
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.doel.1: Get party kites from Kitemaker Pennant in the kite workshop on Kite Island
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.doel.2: Get a barrel of Seashell Lemonade from Lemonadeguh Bubbles on Beach Party Island
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.doel.3: Join the party on Snuggletide Beach: walk to the party spot between the shelter and the tideline
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.klaar.0: Knight... did you see that? She's so low. She hasn't been this low in a hundred years.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.klaar.1: Mother Cloudwhale. She heard the party. Whales love songs, you know.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.klaar.2: Her eyes... they looked tired. And she was trailing a gray little wisp behind her.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.klaar.3: I saw that too. I don't know what it means. But Captain Skyhigh does. He's waiting at the Liftoff Pier, all the way east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.klaar.4: With the whale hanging this low, his airship can finally go up. To Highchonk.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.praat.z4_la: Lanterns for the snuggle party? I've already got three hundred ready! Pink, yellow and mint. And one lilac. Just in case.
I'll bring them to the beach myself. Tell Softie they light up at six o'clock.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.praat.z4_li: A barrel of lemonade for the snuggle party? A barrel?! I'll bring three. With extra seashells.
Bubbles delivers everything. By little boat. It rattles a bit, but it gets there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.praat.z4_vl: Party kites? With little ears and bows? I'll fly twelve of them to the beach. One for every plushie.
And the big one, Gary, gets to come too. He loves parties.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq06_feest.tekst: Foster Mom Softie is throwing a big party on Snuggletide Beach: the twelve plushies are going home, and the refugees are getting a new home. Fetch lanterns, party kites and Seashell Lemonade, and join the party.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq07_opstijgpier.aanbo: The whale is hanging so low my hat nearly snags on her. Highchonk! So close!
Captain Skyhigh has been waiting years for this moment. His airship is moored at the end of the Liftoff Pier, all the way east.
Sail there, knight. Lanternhaven will miss you. But Highchonk... Highchonk needs you. I can feel it in my ears.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq07_opstijgpier.bezig: To the Liftoff Pier in the east, to Captain Skyhigh.
Sail to the Pierhead, the very eastern tip of the island chain
Talk to Pier Keeper Cloudy at the start of the Liftoff Pier
Walk up the Liftoff Pier to the round platform at the end
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq07_opstijgpier.klaar: There you are! The Order knight of Snuggletide! All of Lanternhaven is talking about you. And Highchonk too by now, I bet.
Look up. Mother Cloudwhale. She's hanging so low I could pat her tummy. I won't. That would be rude.
And that gray little wisp? Behind her tail?
...So you see it too. We'll talk about that up there. Not here. Climb aboard, knight. We're going up. Very, very up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq07_opstijgpier.praat: The first airship to Highchonk! I put on my nicest cap for it. And my second-nicest cap underneath.
Captain Skyhigh is at the end of the pier. Go right ahead. Don't look over the edge. Or do. Gorgeous, huh?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_hq07_opstijgpier.tekst: Mother Cloudwhale is hanging low over the sea. For the first time in a hundred years, an airship can go up to Highchonk. Sail to the Pierhead in the east and report to Captain Skyhigh at the end of the Liftoff Pier.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s01_vlieger.aanbod.0: Want to build a kite? A real one? With little ears and a little face? Of course you do.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s01_vlieger.aanbod.1: But the wind ran off with my stuff again. A stick, a piece of cloth, a roll of string and a ribbon. They're somewhere on the island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s01_vlieger.bezig: The stick, the cloth, the string and the ribbon: somewhere on Kite Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s01_vlieger.doel.0: Find the stick, the cloth, the string and the tail ribbon that blew away across Kite Island
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s01_vlieger.klaar.0: It's all here! Look: sticks crossed, cloth over, string on, ribbon under... and then the little ears. Done!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s01_vlieger.klaar.1: Your very own Guh Kite. It's a bit cross-eyed. That's on purpose. That way it sees the wind coming.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s01_vlieger.tekst: Kitemaker Pennant will teach you to build a real Guh Kite. But the materials blew away across Kite Island: a stick, a piece of cloth, a roll of string and a tail ribbon.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s02_wedstrijd.aanbod.0: A contestant! Do you have a kite? A Guh Kite with little ears? Let's see... fine. Cross-eyed, but fine.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s02_wedstrijd.aanbod.1: Stand by the contest pole and hold it in the wind. Half a minute. Don't walk away, or it doesn't count. I'll be counting along.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s02_wedstrijd.bezig: Keep your kite in the wind by the contest pole for half a minute.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s02_wedstrijd.doel.0: Keep your Guh Kite in the wind for half a minute: stay by the contest pole on top of Kite Island with the kite in your bag
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s02_wedstrijd.klaar.0: Half a minute! And it even did a loop-the-loop! Gary has never done that.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s02_wedstrijd.klaar.1: You're the winner of this year's great kite contest. Here's your prize. And tell everyone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s02_wedstrijd.tekst: Wind Master Swoosh is running the great kite contest. Whoever keeps their kite in the wind by the contest pole the longest wins.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s03_vissen.aanbod.0: Fishing is waiting, like I said. But I've been waiting three days now. Nothing's biting. Not for me.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s03_vissen.aanbod.1: Maybe they'll bite for you. Catch five, and I'll know there are still plenty of fish in the sea. Cast your rod and be patient.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s03_vissen.bezig: Catch five fish, anywhere you like along the Lantern Coast.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s03_vissen.doel.0: Catch 5 fish with a fishing rod along the Lantern Coast (from a jetty or from your little boat)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s03_vissen.klaar.0: Five! And they were pink? All of them pink? Then the sea is healthy. What a relief.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s03_vissen.klaar.1: Here, a bowl of fish soup from Shrimp. He gave it to me, but I get one every day. I'm stuffed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s03_vissen.tekst: Fisher Bobber wants to know what's biting along the Lantern Coast. Catch five fish with a fishing rod, anywhere you like in the pink sea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s04_parels.aanbod.0: Oopsie, oopsie. My pearl necklace snapped. Four pearls, splash, into the lagoon.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s04_parels.aanbod.1: Will you dive them up? You'll see them twinkling among the coral. Goggles on, breathe in, and don't stay under too long.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s04_parels.bezig: Four pearls from the lagoon of Coral Bay.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s04_parels.doel.0: Dive up 4 pearls from the lagoon of Coral Bay (little sparkles under water)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s04_parels.klaar.0: All four! And you didn't even get wet. Oh wait, you did. Very wet. Here, a towel. And a reward.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s04_parels.tekst: Dive Master Pearl is missing four shiny pearls from her collection. They rolled off the diving jetty into the lagoon. Dive them up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s05_zeeslurf.aanbod.0: Something lives in the deepest little cave. Big, gray, with a long snoot. It blows gray bubbles. Very sad bubbles.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s05_zeeslurf.aanbod.1: It used to blow pink bubbles. The little fish played with them. Can you make it happy again? Bring friends, it's very big.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s05_zeeslurf.bezig: Cheer up the Gray Sea Snoot in the deepest little cave of Coral Bay.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s05_zeeslurf.doel.0: Cheer up the Gray Sea Snoot in the deepest underwater cave of Coral Bay
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s05_zeeslurf.klaar.0: Pink bubbles! It's blowing pink bubbles again! Look, the little fish are playing with them!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s05_zeeslurf.klaar.1: You're a hero, to the lagoon and to me. Here, a pearl. A real one. From the Sea Snoot itself.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s05_zeeslurf.tekst: In the deepest underwater cave of Coral Bay lies the Gray Sea Snoot: a giant sea cow that has grown very sad. Cheer it up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s06_volleybal.aanbod.0: An opponent! Finally! I've been playing against the sea for four years. The sea always wins.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s06_volleybal.aanbod.1: I hit, you guess where the ball goes: left, middle or right. First to three points wins. My eyes won't give anything away. Honest.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s06_volleybal.bezig: A game of volleyball against Smash: three points!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s06_volleybal.doel.0: Win a game of beach volleyball against Volleyballguh Smash at the volleyball court on Beach Party Island (click Smash)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s06_volleybal.klaar.0: Three points! You read me like a book. A very thin book, with pictures. Another game? Tomorrow. I need to catch my breath.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s06_volleybal.tekst: Volleyballguh Smash always plays alone. Play a game with him: guess where his ball goes and score three points.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s07_limonade.aanbod.0: I'm out of seashells! Without seashells it's just lemonade. Plain lemonade! That won't do.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s07_limonade.aanbod.1: Six pretty seashells, from the beaches around here. Pink, white, striped, doesn't matter. As long as they shine.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s07_limonade.bezig: Six seashells from the beaches of Beach Party Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s07_limonade.doel.0: Pick up 6 pretty seashells on the beaches of Beach Party Island
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s07_limonade.klaar.0: Six! Look how they shine. A little stir... a little taste... perfect. Here, the first bottles are for you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s07_limonade.tekst: Lemonadeguh Bubbles needs six pretty seashells for a new batch of Seashell Lemonade. They're on the beaches of Beach Party Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.aanbod.0: A hundred and forty-four steps. I used to take them two at a time. Now I take them... not at all.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.aanbod.1: The lens is grimy with salt. Will you polish it for me? Then my light will reach all the way to the fog again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.bezig: Polish the big lens at the top of the lighthouse.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.doel.0: Climb the spiral staircase to the top of the big lighthouse on Lighthouse Island
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.doel.1: Polish the big lens at the top of the lighthouse (stand by the lens for a moment)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.klaar.0: Look, the light! It reaches the fog again. Even farther. Thank you, lad. Or lass. Or guh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.klaar.1: Do you know what I once saw, with that light? Long ago. Gray sails in the fog. A hundred ships. They were sailing east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.klaar.2: On the front ship stood a Mika, pointing at my light. With one finger. Then the fog closed in. I've never told anyone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s08_vuurtoren.tekst: Grandpa Lightbeam can't make it up the spiral staircase anymore. Climb to the top of the lighthouse and polish the big lens, so the light reaches far again.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s09_bijen.aanbod.0: Buzz buzz... that means: help! Five of my little bees have escaped. They fell in love with the flowers.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s09_bijen.aanbod.1: Just walk up to them and say 'buzz'. Then they'll follow you back. Little bees are very polite.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s09_bijen.bezig: Five escaped little bees among the flowers of Flower Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s09_bijen.doel.0: Find 5 escaped little bees among the flowers of Flower Island (yellow sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s09_bijen.klaar.0: They're back! All five! Hear how happily they buzz? Here, a jar of pink honey. From them, for you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s09_bijen.tekst: Five little bees belonging to Beekeeper Nectar have escaped and are buzzing somewhere among the flowers of Flower Island. Bring them back to the hive.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s10_kransen.aanbod.0: Twelve plushies are going home. So they deserve twelve wreaths. I've already got six.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s10_kransen.aanbod.1: Will you pick six more flowers for me? The prettiest ones grow in the fields on the south side. Don't pick the bees, okay?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s10_kransen.bezig: Six flowers from the fields of Flower Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s10_kransen.doel.0: Pick 6 flowers in the flower fields of Flower Island (pink sparkles)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s10_kransen.klaar.0: Six gorgeous flowers. A little braiding... look, a wreath. It's for you. You're a bit of a plushie too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s10_kransen.tekst: Wreathmaker Daisy is braiding flower wreaths for the snuggle party. She still needs six flowers from the flower fields.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s11_schildpad.aanbod.0: Old Bobber is hungry. Hear his tummy? That rumbling? No, that's not thunder.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s11_schildpad.aanbod.1: He only eats the yummiest seaweed. The gray creatures on the coast often have it hanging off them. Cheer them up and they'll drop it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s11_schildpad.bezig: Five Yummy Seaweed for Old Bobber.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s11_schildpad.doel.0: Collect 5 Yummy Seaweed from the gray creatures along the Lantern Coast (cheer them up)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s11_schildpad.klaar.0: Look at him chow down! He's swimming his laps faster already. Well, a little faster. A snail's pace faster.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s11_schildpad.klaar.1: Thank you. Here, a scale from his shell. He sheds one every year. It brings good luck.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s11_schildpad.tekst: Hermit Shelldon lives on the sleeping Granny Bobber; her husband Old Bobber swims laps around her. Old Bobber is hungry: he only eats the yummiest seaweed, and the gray creatures on the coast have it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s12_mistbrieven.aanbod: I wrote everything down, on the way. What I saw. So someone would know. But the letters blew away in the fog.
Three letters, somewhere on this island. Will you look for them? You may read them. Actually, you should read them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s12_mistbrieven.bezig: Three of Misty's letters on Mystery Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s12_mistbrieven.doel.0: Find 3 lost letters of Lost Misty on Mystery Island, in the fog
All three. You read them, didn't you? Then now you know too. The gray land. The road. The Bowl.
Thank you. Now I'm not the only one who knows. That feels... lighter. Almost pink.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s12_mistbrieven.tekst: Lost Misty lost three letters on Mystery Island while fleeing. They tell of the gray land. He wants them back, so he never forgets where he came from.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.aanbod.0: Four bowls, four guhs. They're still too shy to come over themselves. Will you take them around?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.aanbod.1: Graysie, Grandpa Slim, Paley and Mama Fluff. Tell them there's always more. Always.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.bezig: Deliver four bowls of soup on Snuggletide Beach.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.doel.0: Bring a bowl of soup to Graysie, on a little blanket by the shelter
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.doel.1: Bring a bowl of soup to Grandpa Slim, on the bench by the soup stand
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.doel.2: Bring a bowl of soup to Paley, by the clothesline
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.doel.3: Bring a bowl of soup to Mama Fluff, at the entrance of the shelter
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.klaar.0: They ate every last drop! Even Grandpa Slim. He never finished anything. That wasn't allowed back there, he said.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.klaar.1: Here, a bowl for you. You've earned it. There's always more.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.praat.z4_grij: Soup! For me? With a spoon? Thank you... it's warm. So warm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.praat.z4_mama: See my ears? The soup is turning them pink. Really. Just look.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.praat.z4_opa_: A whole bowl. Just for me. I... I don't know what to say. Thank you, knight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.praat.z4_vaal: It smells like carrots and sunshine. Where I come from, soup smells like nothing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s13_soep.tekst: Soupguh Spoony has four bowls of warm soup ready for the guhs from the east. Take them around Snuggletide Beach.
Five hooks are still empty. By the jetties, on the quay and on the square. Five empty hooks means five dark spots.
Here, five lanterns. Walk up to an empty hook and they'll hang themselves up. They're very helpful.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s14_lampionnen.bezig: Hang five lanterns on the empty hooks in Lanternhaven.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s14_lampionnen.doel.0: Hang 5 lanterns on the empty hooks in Lanternhaven (golden sparkles by the jetties, the quay and the square)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s14_lampionnen.klaar.0: Just look at it glow! Now everyone can see the way. Plushies, little boats, and whales too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s14_lampionnen.tekst: Lanternmaker Glowwick wants to hang five new lanterns in Lanternhaven, so the plushies can see the way home. Hang them on the empty hooks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s15_strandavond.aanbod: A party! Now! Because parties don't wait. Well, sometimes they do. But not this one.
Come stand by the campfire. Your feet will move all by themselves. That's the fire. It's a dance fire.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s15_strandavond.bezig: A little dance by the campfire on Beach Party Island.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s15_strandavond.doel.0: Dance along by the campfire on Beach Party Island (stand by the fire for a while)
What a dance! You did the wave, the crab AND the whale. I don't even know that last one!
Here, some marshmallows. Toasted. A bit black. That's the yummiest side.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s15_strandavond.tekst: Partyguh Confetti is throwing a party by the campfire on Beach Party Island. Dance along: stand by the campfire for a while and let your feet do the work.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s16_flessenpost.aanbod: I wrote a little letter. For Granny. She still lives there. In the gray land.
It says: 'Dear Granny, everything is pink here. I had soup. Come too.' Will you throw it into the Ring Current? It goes everywhere. Softie says so.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s16_flessenpost.bezig: Throw the message in a bottle into the Ring Current, south of Snuggletide Beach.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s16_flessenpost.doel.0: Sail with the message in a bottle to the foam stripes of the Ring Current, south of Snuggletide Beach
It's floating! It's floating east! Do you think Granny will get it?
The sea brought your plushie here. So it'll bring this letter to Granny too.
...That's the sweetest thing anyone has ever said to me. Here, I made you a drawing. That's you. On a whale.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z4_s16_flessenpost.tekst: Graysie wrote a little letter to her granny, who still lives in the east. Throw the message in a bottle into the Ring Current at the edge of the sea: it swirls past every coast, including the ones in the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.aa: A Knight of Highchonk with only two titles? That won't do. It's not in the rulebook. I just checked.
Reach level 58 as a Snuggle Knight. Then the whole Cloudwatch will march for you. Left, right, left, cuddle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.be: Level 58 as a Snuggle Knight, then to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.do: Reach level 58 as a Snuggle Knight
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.kl: Cloudwatch, atten-shuuun! For the hero of Highchonk: the highest title of the Snuggle Order!
Your specialization is now at its strongest. Call me Feather. No, call me 'Captain'. No, Feather after all.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_adv58_knuffelridder.te: Highchonk is saved, Knight. The Cloudwatch wants to give you the highest title of the Snuggle Order. Reach class level 58 as a Snuggle Knight and come back to Captain Springfeather on the Academy training ground.
