vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.aanbod.0: Welcome to the Highchonk Skyport! First time? I can tell from your mouth. It's hanging open.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.aanbod.1: The Queen is expecting you. Head south, up Gentleheart Lane, then east to the grand staircase. The palace is at the top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.bezig: To Queen Gentleheart, in the throne room on Palace Hill.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.0: Fly up to Highchonk on the first airship from the Lanternhaven Liftoff Pier
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.1: Report to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport desk (north side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.2: Walk south from the Skyport to Gentleheart Lane in the middle of the city
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.doel.3: Go to Queen Gentleheart in the throne room: follow the lane east, climb the grand staircase up Palace Hill and enter the palace
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.0: There you are. Come here. No, closer. There. A cuddle from a queen, you don't get one of those every day.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.1: Wahoognir said you would come. He landed on the roof last week. The roof tiles are still pink.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.2: What a city. I didn't know so many guhs could live together.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.3: On the back of Mother Cloudwhale. She's been swimming through the sky for ages, and she carries us. Because chonk is light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.klaar.4: But I didn't call you here just for a cuddle. Something terrible has happened. Sit down. On a cushion. There are plenty.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq01_stad.tekst: Mother Cloudwhale has sunk low over the sea. From the Lanternhaven Liftoff Pier, the first airship sails up: to Highchonk, the capital of all guhs, on the whale's back. Queen Gentleheart is waiting for you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.0: Last night the Torn Page was stolen. From the Council Hall. Under lock and key.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.1: That page holds the oldest story of the Order. And on the back... something no one may ever sing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.3: Only the High Council. Four guhs I've trusted for years. One of them is a traitor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.aanbod.4: Inspector Snoop is in the side room of the Council Hall. Investigate with him. Quietly. No one may notice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.bezig: Inspector Snoop, the lectern in the Council Hall, and then Councilor Inkblot in the archive.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.doel.0: Report to Inspector Snoop in the side room of the Council Hall, next to the palace on Palace Hill
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.doel.1: Examine the lectern with the old books, in the middle of the Council Hall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.doel.2: Question Councilor Inkblot, the archivist, in the university archive (north side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.klaar.0: Gray hairs on the lectern. A tea stain. And a spare key at the Chancellery. Hmmm.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.klaar.1: You've got your Detective's Notebook already? Good. Write down everything you find. Right-click and you'll see the evidence board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.klaar.2: One more thing: Captain Springfeather of the Academy says there's a mole in the Cloudwatch. That's where we go next.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.praat.z5_: Aha! The knight of the Order. The Queen said you were coming. Inspector Snoop, pleased to meet you. My mustache is real.
Here, a Detective's Notebook. Everything you find goes in it. Start at the lectern, that's where the page was.
And then question Councilor Inkblot. She has the key to the old books. She's in the university archive.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq02_verraad.tekst: The Torn Page has been stolen from the Council Hall: the oldest story of the Order. There's a traitor on the High Council. Inspector Snoop will help you investigate.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.aanbod.0: The back door of the Council Hall was open. No signs of a break-in. Someone with a key... or someone from the Cloudwatch.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.aanbod.1: Captain Springfeather is waiting for you on the Academy training ground. Look in the cadets' lockers.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.bezig: Captain Springfeather, the lockers in the barracks, and then Cadet Tuft.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.doel.0: Talk to Captain Springfeather on the training ground of the Cloudwatch Academy (south side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.doel.1: Search the cadets' lockers in the Academy barracks
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.doel.2: Question Cadet Tuft by the Academy barracks
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.klaar.0: A command note with a paw stamp. Paws with PADS. And notes under a soup bowl in the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.klaar.1: Poor Tuft. He only wanted his family back. Someone used him.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.klaar.2: Off to the Great Soup Kitchen. Cook Ladle knows everything that goes on there. Bring an appetite.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.praat.z5_veer: A knight of the Order! Welcome to my Academy. Call me Feather.
Someone in the Cloudwatch left the back door of the Council Hall open. I'm sure of it: the guard was there, and he left it open.
Look in the cadets' lockers, in the barracks. I hope I'm wrong.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq03_mol.tekst: Someone left the back door of the Council Hall open. Captain Springfeather thinks there's a mole in the Cloudwatch.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.aanbod.0: The Great Soup Kitchen. Everyone goes there. Cadets, councilors, and the Unchonked from the east.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.aanbod.1: Talk to Cook Ladle. And lend a hand: whoever serves the soup hears the gossip.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.bezig: Cook Ladle, four bowls of soup, and Skinny Minnie in the Great Soup Kitchen.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.0: Question Cook Ladle by the giant cauldron in the Great Soup Kitchen (south side of the market)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.1: Serve a bowl of soup to the four Unchonked in line at the cauldron (click them)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.2: Question Skinny Minnie at the long table in the Great Soup Kitchen
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.doel.3: Listen to Skinny Minnie's story: how she escaped from the east
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.klaar.0: A guh with a TAIL. Who steals cheese. Hmm. Hmmmm. I know only one kind of creature that's that crazy about ripe cheese.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.klaar.1: But who on the Council would hide a tail under their cape?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.klaar.2: Next lead: the Skyport. Harbormaster Weathervane keeps a logbook. Who sneaks off at night?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq04_soep.tekst: The command notes came from under a soup bowl in the Great Soup Kitchen. That's where the Unchonked eat, the skinny refugees from the east. Anyone sneaking around there at night gets noticed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.aanbod.0: The Skyport. Harbormaster Weathervane writes down every flight. Even the ones at night.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.aanbod.1: And Councilor Goldthread flies off often. Very often. Question him afterward, at the bank on the market.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.bezig: Harbormaster Weathervane, the night logbook, and Councilor Goldthread at the bank.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.doel.0: Talk to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport desk (north side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.doel.1: Read the night logbook on the Skyport desk
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.doel.2: Question Councilor Goldthread, the treasurer, at the bank counter on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.klaar.0: Goldthread visits his mother. What a sweet treasurer. We can cross him off the list.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.klaar.1: But the seal of the Chancellery... on a secret booking to the east. Across the Cloud Sea. Where no one flies.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.klaar.2: Two councilors left: General Downfeather and Chancellor Softpelt. We'll question them both.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.praat.z5_: The night logbook? Of course. It's all in there. Who, when, where to. It's on the desk.
Though there's one booking I never understood. Every Thursday night. To the east, across the Cloud Sea. Nobody wants to go there. See for yourself.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq05_logboek.tekst: A traitor has to take their secrets somewhere. The Skyport is the only way off the whale.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.aanbod.0: Two more interrogations. General Downfeather in his tower. And Chancellor Softpelt in the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.aanbod.1: A tip from an old detective: take along that piece of ripe cheese the Queen gave you. A cheese test. You never know.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.bezig: General Downfeather in the Academy tower, and Chancellor Softpelt in the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.doel.0: Question General Downfeather, at the top of the tower of the Cloudwatch Academy
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.doel.1: Question Chancellor Softpelt in the Chancellery, next to the throne room in the palace (bring the piece of cheese)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.klaar.0: A general who sings in secret. A chancellor who refuses soup but snatches cheese. My mustache is twitching. That's a good sign.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.klaar.1: All the clues are in. Time for the evidence board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq06_verhoren.tekst: Two councilors left. General Downfeather was nowhere to be found at night. Chancellor Softpelt holds the seal of the Chancellery.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.aanbod: Look at the board. Ten clues. Four suspects. Three clues all point the same way.
Who has a tail, the seal of the Chancellery, and a soft spot for ripe cheese? Point him out. I've already called the Council together.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.bezig: Point out the traitor on the evidence board.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.doel.0: Point out the traitor on the evidence board: with Inspector Snoop in the side room of the Council Hall (or right-click your Detective's Notebook)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.doel.1: Unmask the traitor in the Council Hall
A Mika. On the High Council. For three years. And nobody noticed, because he handed out such yummy cookies.
Pinkie Silvertail, of the Ring Finger. He's run off with the page. To the blowhole! If he sings the lullaby backwards...
...Mother Cloudwhale will have a gray dream. And a whale with bad dreams sinks. With the whole city on top. After him!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq07_bewijsbord.tekst: All the clues have been found. Lay them side by side on the evidence board, and point out the traitor. In front of the whole High Council.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.bezi: After Silvertail, into the blowhole. And cheer up the gray dream.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.doel: Chase Silvertail to the middle blowhole, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden (west side)
Defeat Pinkie Silvertail in the Cloudwhale Dream, deep inside the whale
Cheer up Mother Cloudwhale's Gray Dream, in the Cloudwhale Dream
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.klaa: You're back! And the whale is swimming straight again. The streets don't wobble anymore. Hear that? She's humming.
And you've got the page. May I? Thank you. I'll read it aloud. Everyone may know now.
'Long ago, at the edge of the world, there lived an ordinary little Mika. Only hungrier than the rest.'
'He stole a cheese nibble from a guh, and for one moment felt something warm: chonk. Then it was gone. So he took another. And another.'

'For chonk only grows when you share it. What you grab melts in your paws. His grasp reached ever farther. He put on a stolen little crown and called himself Emperor. He built a keep around a bowl as big as a lake: the Empty Bowl. Never full.'
The Gray Emperor Mika. Keep Neverenough. That's where all the grayness comes from. It was on this page all along.
But first: Mother Cloudwhale has to wake up. All the way. Sing the lullaby, the RIGHT way round, by her eye.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq08_wolkwaldroom.teks: Pinkie Silvertail jumped into the middle blowhole with the Torn Page, deep into the whale. There he's singing the lullaby backwards. Mother Cloudwhale is dreaming gray, and she's sinking.
Mother Cloudwhale's eye lies beneath the Eye Garden, all the way at the western tip. There's a balcony.
Sing the lullaby the right way round. You may sing off-key. General Downfeather does too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.bezig: To the Eye Garden balcony, and sing.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.doel.0: Go to the Eye Garden balcony, above Mother Cloudwhale's eye (western tip, south side)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.doel.1: Sing the lullaby to Mother Cloudwhale, on the Eye Garden balcony
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.klaar.0: She winked at you. She only does that once a century. Or once a day, according to Partyguh Confetti.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.klaar.1: Highchonk is safe. Thanks to you. Kneel for a moment. No, not so low, your cushion will fall out.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.klaar.2: I hereby name you Knight of Highchonk. With a cuddle. That's mandatory.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq09_slaaplied.tekst: The lullaby is on the back of the page. Sing it the right way round, by Mother Cloudwhale's eye, and she'll wake up completely.
Silvertail had a desk in the Chancellery. There's bound to be mail from his boss there. Have a look.
And then look east, from the piers of the Skyport. Stars have been going out there for days. One by one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.bezig: The desk in the Chancellery, the eastern pier, and Harbormaster Weathervane.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.0: Search the desk in the Chancellery, next to the throne room
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.1: Look east from the end of the Skyport's eastern pier
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.2: Take a good look at the stars in the east
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.doel.3: Ask Harbormaster Weathervane about an airship to the east
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.klaar.0: To the east? Nobody flies there. Too far for an airship. That's where the Great Mainland lies.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.klaar.1: ...Unless Mother Cloudwhale swims there herself. She felt it, the Queen says. Those stars. She wants to help.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.klaar.2: Feel that? The streets are trembling. She's going for a swim. Hold on tight!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_hq10_stormrand.tekst: Silvertail worked for the Ring Finger, one of the Emperor's generals. There's still mail in his Chancellery. And in the east, beyond the Cloud Sea, stars are going out.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.aanbod.0: Cloudberries make the soup pink. And sweet. And a little floaty.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.aanbod.1: They grow in Tail Park and in the Eye Garden. Pick eight, and everyone gets a pink bowl.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.bezig: Eight cloudberries from Tail Park and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.doel.0: Pick 8 cloudberries in Tail Park (east side) and the Eye Garden (west side): look for the pink sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.klaar.0: Look how pink! Graysie is laughing. Graysie has never laughed before. Thank you, knight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s01_bessen.tekst: The cauldron of the Great Soup Kitchen never runs empty, but the cloudberries do. They grow in Tail Park and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.aanbod.0: Flop is gone. He has one ear. I was in the big church. Looking at the light. He was still there then.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.aanbod.1: Will you look for him? He's very soft. And a little gray. Like I used to be.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.bezig: Flop is somewhere in the Order Cathedral.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.doel.0: Find plushie bunny Flop behind the statue of the First Snuggle, at the back of the Order Cathedral
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.doel.1: Bring Flop back to Fluffy in the Great Soup Kitchen
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.klaar.0: FLOP! You're back! He smells like church. He likes that, I can tell.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.klaar.1: Thank you. Flop says so too. He's just a little shy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s02_flap.tekst: Fluffy has lost her plushie bunny Flop. She was in the cathedral looking at the light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.aanbod.0: Three letters. One for the mail to the east, one for the evening song in the cathedral, and one for my granddaughter.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.aanbod.1: She's sitting right nearby, but she'd rather read mail than listen to her grandpa. Kids.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.bezig: Harbormaster Weathervane, Sister Softsong and Fluffy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.doel.0: Bring a letter to Harbormaster Weathervane at the Skyport (for the mail to the east)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.doel.1: Bring a letter to Sister Softsong at the altar of the Order Cathedral (for the evening song)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.doel.2: Bring the last little letter to Fluffy in the Great Soup Kitchen (her grandpa wrote it)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.klaar.0: All three delivered? Then you're the fastest postguh on the whale. My mustache is turning pink. Look. A little.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.praat.z5_h: A letter to the east? It'll go with the next ship. I promise.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.praat.z5_p: A letter from Grandpa! 'Dear Fluffy, finish your soup and cuddle Flop.' I already do. Both.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.praat.z5_z: A letter for the evening song? We'll sing it tonight. Everyone in the cathedral will think of the east for a moment.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s03_brieven.tekst: Grandpa Graywhisker writes letters every day. They need to go to the right guhs in Highchonk, who can send them onward.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.aanbod.0: The second moon. The Eye. Every year it looms bigger in the sky. And grayer. I don't like it one bit.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.aanbod.1: Measure it for me, through the telescope in the observatory. I'm too old for those stairs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.doel.0: Climb up to the observatory on the corner of the university (northeast side of Highchonk)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.doel.1: Measure the Eye through the big telescope in the observatory (click when you're there)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.klaar.0: Twelve inches? Last year it was ten. It's coming closer. Or it's getting bigger. Neither is good news.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.klaar.1: I'll write it down. Science is: writing down what's scary, so you can make it less scary later.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s04_oog.tekst: Professor Specsworth wants to know how big the second moon, the Eye, looks in the sky. You can measure it from the observatory.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.aanbod.0: A whale breathes through her blowholes. Three of them, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.aanbod.1: Stand by each blowhole and listen. A healthy cloudwhale sighs like a pillow being fluffed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.bezig: Three blowholes, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.doel.0: Listen at the northern blowhole, between the cathedral and the Eye Garden
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.klaar.0: She sighs like a pillow? All of them? Good. Healthy and content. Just like me after a nap.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s05_adem.tekst: Mother Cloudwhale breathes through three blowholes. Professor Specsworth wants to know if she's still breathing healthily.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.aanbod.0: The first trial of the Cloudwatch: the Cloud Course. Four posts, in order. Ready? Go!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.bezig: Four posts on the training ground, in order.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.0: Run to the first post, northwest on the Academy training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.1: Run to the second post, northeast on the training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.2: Run to the third post, southeast on the training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.doel.3: Run to the fourth post, southwest on the training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.klaar.0: Splendid! Faster than Downfeather, and he runs like there's a cookie at the finish line.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s06_parcours.tekst: Every Cloudwatch cadet runs the Cloud Course: four posts on the training ground. Captain Springfeather wants to see if you can do it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.aanbod.0: The second trial: look after your comrades. Cadet Down is lost again. He's probably standing on a Skyport pier, looking at clouds.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.aanbod.1: Bring him back. Slowly. He has short little legs.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.bezig: Cadet Down, from the Skyport to the Academy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.doel.0: Pick up Cadet Down from the western pier of the Skyport and bring him to the Academy training ground
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.klaar.0: Down! There you are. Thank the knight. ...No, don't salute, your helmet... Too late.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s07_kadet.tekst: Cadet Down has wandered off again. He's on a Skyport pier. Bring him back to the Academy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.aanbod.0: Help! Three parcels, three stalls, one Lindy. Flour for the baker, cloth for the tailor, glimmers for the jeweler.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.bezig: The baker, the tailor and the jeweler on the market.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.doel.0: Bring a bag of flour to Baker Cloudbun, at the bakery stall on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.doel.1: Bring a roll of cloth to Tailor Hem on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.doel.2: Bring a little box of glimmers to Jeweler Glimmer on the market
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.klaar.0: All delivered? You're a hero. A market hero. That's almost as good as a regular hero.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.praat.z5_bak: Flour! I bake cloudbuns with that. Here, one for you. Eat it quick, before it floats away.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.praat.z5_juw: Glimmers! Oooh. They glimmer. That's the whole point.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.praat.z5_kle: Velvet-soft cloth! I'll make a new cape out of it. Not as long as the Chancellor's. Nobody wants a cape that long.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s08_markt.tekst: It's busy on the Highchonk market. Stallguh Lindy has parcels for three other stalls.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.aanbod.0: Four trees around the pond. They wobble when the whale swims, and then they spill their water. Will you give them a sip?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.bezig: Four blossom trees around the pond in Tail Park.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.0: Water the first blossom tree, southwest of the pond in Tail Park
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.1: Water the second blossom tree, southeast of the pond
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.2: Water the third blossom tree, northeast of the pond
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.doel.3: Water the fourth blossom tree, northwest of the pond
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.klaar.0: Look, they're blooming again! The petals are drifting all the way down to the sea.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s09_bloesem.tekst: The blossom trees in Tail Park are thirsty. Gardenguh Sprig has one watering can and four trees.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.aanbod.0: Shh. The Queen's crown is fraying. Three balls of yarn have rolled away. One across the market, one across the palace courtyard, and one...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.aanbod.1: ...walked into the university with a professor. Don't ask how.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.doel.0: Find 3 balls of pink yarn: on the market, in the palace courtyard and in the university (pink fluff)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.klaar.0: All three! I'll knit them back in tonight, while she sleeps. She won't notice a thing. She always notices. She just never says anything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s10_wol.tekst: Three balls of pink yarn have rolled out of the Queen's knitted crown. Court Lady Needles wants them back before the Queen notices.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.aanbod: The first knights of the Order came here, long ago. They stood beneath the two roses and then by the First Snuggle.
Do as they did. You don't have to sing. You may, though.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.bezig: The northern and southern rose windows, and the First Snuggle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.doel.0: Stand beneath the northern rose window, in the transept of the Order Cathedral
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.doel.1: Stand beneath the southern rose window
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.doel.2: Stand by the golden statue of the First Snuggle, at the back of the cathedral
You saw it, didn't you? The light falls right on the statue. As if the sun itself is hugging someone.
That's how the Order began. With one cuddle. And then another. That's how chonk grows.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z5_s11_knuffellied.tekst: In the Order Cathedral they sing the song of the First Snuggle every evening. Sister Softsong wants you to see the light the way the first knights saw it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.aanbod.0: Knight! Look east! The Cloud Sea has parted. There, that pink stripe. That's land!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.aanbod.1: Mother Cloudwhale is already swimming toward it. For you. She felt it, the Queen says. Stars are going out over there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.aanbod.2: As soon as she's still, Line E flies from Tail Harbor. At the very back, on her tail. To Rose Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.bezig: To Tail Harbor, take Line E to Rose Gorge, then to Gorge Mother Rosie in the Treasure Room.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.0: Watch Mother Cloudwhale swim east (the cutscene starts by itself; otherwise at Tail Harbor, at the very back on Highchonk's tail)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.1: Take Line E from Highchonk Tail Harbor to Rose Gorge Skyport
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.2: Report to Harbormaster Hourglass at the desk of Rose Gorge Skyport (north rim of the gorge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.doel.3: Go down the wall stairs to the bottom of the gorge and walk to the Treasure Room in the eastern end wall: Gorge Mother Rosie
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.0: A knight! From the sky! Come in, dear. Mind the threshold, it's three thousand years old and a bit grumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.1: I'm Rosie, the gorge mother. I saw the whale this morning. A little cloud with a tail, on the horizon. What a sight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.2: Why are the nights so dark here?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.3: Ah. You've noticed. The Star Beacons are out. All five. Snuffed out one by one, over the past few weeks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.4: Caravans steer by those beacons to the Mother Oasis, the source of all our water. Without beacons they get lost. And the river sinks.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.klaar.5: Granny Date wants to set out anyway. She's the bravest caravanguh I know. She's on Rose Square. Help her.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq01_land.tekst: Mother Cloudwhale swims east with all of Highchonk, until the pink cliffs of the Great Mainland loom up. That's where the Silklands lie. Line E flies from Highchonk Tail Harbor to Rose Gorge Skyport.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.aanbod.0: There you are. Rosie said a knight was coming. You look like you can lift things. Good.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.aanbod.1: My caravan is going to Saffron Gate. Without beacons, yes. I've got a teapot and a good feeling. That's enough.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.aanbod.2: Help me pack: dates, water, carpets. And get a humpguh from Bumpy. You weren't planning to walk, were you?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.bezig: Dates, waterskins, carpets, and a humpguh from Stable Master Bumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.0: Pack the baskets of dates, next to the caravan on Rose Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.1: Fill the waterskins at the star-shaped fountain on Rose Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.2: Get the rolled-up carpets from the carpet shop of Carpet Trader Fringe (Rose Square)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.doel.3: Choose your own humpguh from Stable Master Bumpy in the humpguh stable on Rose Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.klaar.0: All packed! And look at you on that humpguh. You two match. Both a little lumpy.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.klaar.1: This is Lumpy, my humpguh. And that little dumpling hopping along behind her is Lumpkin. Her little one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.klaar.2: We leave tomorrow. Up through the Siq, and then along the dunes. La-la-LAA-la-lo.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.praat.z6: A knight for a humpguh! Look at them standing there. Sand pink, saffron, cloud white, cinnamon. They're all just as sweet.
A humpguh walks on sand like it's a cushion. And it has two seats. Bring someone along.
This one's choosing you, I see. It's licking your ear. That means: yes.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq02_karavaan.tekst: Granny Date is setting off with her little caravan to Saffron Gate, even though the Star Beacons are out. She could use a few extra hands. And you could use a humpguh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.aanbod.0: Ready? Then off we go. By day the sand is too hot, so we travel at dusk. Without stars. How exciting.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.aanbod.1: Up through the Siq, and then along the dunes. Stay close. And keep an eye on Lumpkin, she chases everything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.bezig: Through the Siq, along the dunes, find Lumpkin, and on to the West Gate of Saffron Gate.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.0: Ride with the caravan up through the Siq to the plateau (the narrow canyon in the northeast of Rose Gorge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.1: Follow the dune road to the caravan's resting spot on the western edge of the Pink Dunes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.2: Lumpkin is lost! Find the baby humpguh behind the tall dune south of the resting spot
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.3: From the dune ridge east of the resting spot, see what's swimming through the sand
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.4: Bring the caravan to the West Gate of Saffron Gate, at the end of the caravan road
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.doel.5: Find Granny Date in the Caravanserai by the West Gate of Saffron Gate
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.klaar.0: We made it! Saffron Gate! Can you smell that? Cardamom, roses and river water.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.klaar.1: That thing in the dunes... Queen Wormelina. She used to sing, for the caravans. Now she's gray and hungry.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.klaar.2: Everything's been going wrong since the beacons went out. Go to Sultana Raisin in the palace. She needs to know there's a knight here.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq03_duinen.tekst: Granny Date's caravan travels up through the Siq and along the Pink Dunes to Saffron Gate. Without beacons. Stay close.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.aanbod.0: The Sultana needs to know, knight. Over the bridge at the West Gate, then the palace with the golden dome. You can't miss it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.aanbod.1: Ask for Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick. He arranges everything. Even things that don't need arranging.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.bezig: Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick, the Sultana in the Hall of Mirrors, and Twinkle's telescope.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.0: Ask Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick for an audience, at the iwan in front of the Hall of Mirrors in the Raisin Palace (north bank)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.1: Go to Sultana Raisin on the throne at the back of the Hall of Mirrors
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.2: Learn to read the stars: connect the constellation The Little Snuggle at the big copper telescope, at the top of Twinkle's Observatory (northeast of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.doel.3: Talk to Stargazer Twinkle next to the big telescope in the Observatory
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.0: You got it! The Little Snuggle, from ear to snoot. That's how you read the stars.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.1: The vision in the water... Mother Spring. The old spirit of the Mother Oasis. I thought she was a fairy tale.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.2: Take my Star Lens with you. It's empty, but with every beacon you light, it catches a tiny shard of starlight. Then you can see the night sky even by day.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.klaar.3: Start at the Palm Beacon, above the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges. Palmguh Datepit lives there. He knows the way.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.praat.z6_: An audience? Of course. After tea. Well, a knight may skip the line. I'll just put the tea aside.
Go on through the iwan, into the Hall of Mirrors. Don't stare into the mirrors too long. Master Gleam polishes them. Very... thoroughly.
Strange, by the way. Yesterday I saw myself walking down the hall. While I was standing right here. I should drink less tea.
A knight from the sky. On the back of a whale. What a time to be a sultana.
Look. The star map of the Silklands. Five beacons: Palm, Salt, Ruin, Dune and Oasis. Together they point to the Mother Oasis.
They've all been snuffed out. The river drops every week. If the Mother Oasis dries up, Saffron Gate dries up.
Go to Stargazer Twinkle in the Observatory. Whoever wants to light the beacons must first learn to read the stars.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq04_sultane.tekst: Sultana Raisin keeps the old star map of the Silklands. Grand Vizier Cinnamon Stick arranges the audience. And Stargazer Twinkle can teach you how to read the stars.
The Palm Gorges lie southwest of the city, along the river. Follow the water toward the sea until you hear the waterfalls.
Datepit knows the way up. And watch out for the Mikas with the big snuffer hats. Lamp Snuffers. They snuff out the beacons.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.bezig: Palmguh Datepit, up the waterfalls, light the Palm Beacon, and back to Twinkle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.0: Talk to Palmguh Datepit at the lowest waterfall of the Palm Gorges (southwest of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.1: Climb up along the waterfalls to the Palm Beacon, on top of the plateau
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.2: Relight The Palm Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.doel.3: Tell Stargazer Twinkle in Saffron Gate Observatory that the Palm Beacon is burning
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.klaar.0: The Palm Beacon is burning! I saw the beam from my telescope. Look, the lens caught a tiny shard.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.klaar.1: And that voice in the light... Mother Spring. So she's real. What did she say? A straw of gray? Brrr.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.klaar.2: Say, you've got stardust on your coat. Carpet Weaver Button in the bazaar can make something lovely with that. Something that flies...
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.praat.z: A knight with a Star Lens! Twinkle sent you, I see. Then you're here for the Palm Beacon.
Follow the water up. Past the three waterfalls. On top of the plateau stands the beacon, among the old palms.
There are Mikas sneaking around with snuffer hats. Lamp Snuffers. If you see them: shoo them away. They don't like light.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq05_palmbaken.tekst: The first beacon stands above the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges. At night you have to follow the constellation The Date Palm, or it won't flare up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.aanbod.0: Stardust! On your coat! Who told you I adore that? Twinkle. That chatterbox.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.aanbod.1: With stardust and silk I weave a carpet that flies. But I'm out of silk. The cocoons are all gone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.aanbod.2: Mulberry trees grow along the river in the Palm Gorges. They're full of cocoons. Pick five, then I'll weave.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.bezig: Five cocoons, to Button in the bazaar, and a test flight to the Saffron Bridge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.0: Pick 5 silk cocoons from the mulberry trees along the river in the Palm Gorges: look for the white sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.1: Bring the cocoons to Carpet Weaver Button in the sewing workshop of the Grand Bazaar (south bank of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.2: Test flight! Glide on your carpet over the rooftops to the pavilion on the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.doel.3: Fly back to Button in the Grand Bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.klaar.0: You're flying! Well, gliding. A carpet can't fly high, it gets dizzy. But over water and sand: lovely.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.klaar.1: Let it slide to a stop when you halt. A carpet doesn't like braking. Just like me on a slippery floor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.klaar.2: And now: Granny Date is looking for you, in the Caravanserai. The caravan wants to go to the Salt Flats. That's where the second beacon is.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.praat.z6_k: Cocoons! Five! Sit down. Wait a moment. Rustle, click, whoosh...
Done. A carpet of starsilk. With tassels. Tassels are important.
Sit on it. Legs crossed. Now lean forward, very gently... See? It floats! Try flying to the Saffron Bridge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq06_tapijt.tekst: With silk cocoons from the mulberry trees and stardust from the Palm Beacon, Carpet Weaver Button can weave a flying carpet.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.aanbod: There you are! With a carpet, I see. Fancy. My caravan leaves for the Salt Flats tonight. The Salt Beacon is there.
We'll camp by the campfire. I hum the caravan song, you light the beacon. Fair split.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.bezig: The caravan camp, the Salt Beacon, escaping the Salt Colossus, the Mika camp, and back to Twinkle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.0: Travel to the caravan camp by the campfire on the Salt Flats (southeast of Saffron Gate)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.1: Relight The Salt Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.2: Dodge The Salt Colossus, who wakes up at the Salt Beacon (you don't have to defeat him)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.3: Search the abandoned Mika Camp on the eastern edge of the Salt Flats
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.doel.4: Bring what you found to Stargazer Twinkle in Saffron Gate Observatory
A gray letter. 'To the Ring Finger.' Let me see... oh no. Oh no no no.
'Madam Duchess. The Empty Lens on the tower works. With every snuffed beacon it drinks more starlight. Your rings are nearly full. The oasis is almost hidden enough to pump dry. Your Knuckle, G.'
A tower. By the Mother Oasis. Someone is snuffing out the stars to drink the oasis dry. For the Emperor.
There's one more beacon: the Ruin Beacon. But the way there is on a compass of the old Star Guhs. And that's in The Sunken Observatory.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq07_zoutvlakte.tekst: Granny Date's caravan is camping on the Salt Flats. That's where the Salt Beacon is, and something big sleeps under the salt.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.aanb: Professor Dust has been digging in Ruin Valley for years. He knows everything about the Star Guhs. Especially what lies under the sand.
Go to his camp first. And bring friends to the Observatory. Something in there blows out the fire bowls.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.bezi: Professor Dust, The Sunken Observatory, the Star Compass, the Ruin Beacon, and back to Twinkle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.doel: Talk to Professor Dust in the archaeologists' camp in Ruin Valley (northeast of Saffron Gate)
Go to the entrance of The Sunken Observatory, the dome half sunk into the sand
Get the Star Compass from The Sunken Observatory (a dungeon: bring friends)
Relight The Ruin Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
Bring the Star Compass to Stargazer Twinkle in Saffron Gate Observatory
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.klaa: The Star Compass! After six hundred years. Professor Dust will be so jealous. May I hold it? Just for a bit?
Look: it doesn't point north. It points to where the stars come together. But for that you need mirrors.
Lots of mirrors. A thousand mirrors... The Sultana's Hall of Mirrors! Take the compass there.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.praa: A knight! In my camp! Careful with that jar, there's a little chunk of meteorite in it. Or jam. I don't remember.
The Sunken Observatory is over there, half in the sand. The Star Guhs kept their compass there. But something lives in it now.
A Mika with a giant snuffer. And an old giant guh made of star stone, very gray. Be kind to him. He isn't angry. Just tired.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq08_sterrenwacht.teks: In Ruin Valley lies The Sunken Observatory of the old Star Guhs. Inside: the Star Compass, which knows the way to the Ruin Beacon and to the oasis.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.aanbo: Take the compass to the Hall of Mirrors. The Sultana knows about it, I sent a pigeon. The mirrors will do the rest.
I'd love to come along, but I'm scared of mirrors. They always look back.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.bezig: The Sultana, the compass in the Hall of Mirrors, and chasing the Mirror Vizier across the rooftops.
Take the compass to the Hall of Mirrors in the Raisin Palace (north bank) and place it in the middle of the runner, under the golden dome. The Sultana is watching
Chase the Mirror Vizier across the rooftops: first to the big golden dome of the bazaar
After him, to the wind tower with the pink dome in the residential quarter
And on to the East Gate, the tower with the guh ears
From the East Gate, see where the Mirror Vizier flees to
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.klaar: Master Gleam. Twenty years he polished my mirrors. Twenty years he watched, in every mirror.
Master Gleam was the Mirror Vizier. A Mika illusionist, the Knuckle of the Ring Finger. He stole the reflection of the path. But not all of it.
Look. In the corner of the biggest mirror, a little piece got left behind. A path over the dune, to the east.
The Dune Beacon and the Oasis Beacon are the last two. Take the whole caravan with you. Granny Date is already waiting.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq09_spiegelzaal.tekst: In the Hall of Mirrors, a thousand mirrors bounce the light of the beacons. With the Star Compass they reveal the hidden path to the Mother Oasis.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.aanbod: Two beacons left. The Dune Beacon on the highest dune, and the Oasis Beacon at the oasis itself. Then the path will be fully visible.
Granny Date wants to bring the whole caravan. Every caravan in the city, even. That'll be quite a parade. Off you go. I'll wave.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.bezig: Granny Date, the Dune Beacon, the mirage, the Oasis Beacon, Mother Spring, and the gray tower.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.0: Pick up Granny Date and the great caravan at the Caravanserai by the West Gate
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.1: Relight The Dune Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.2: Follow the star path along the East Route through the mirage (between the Salt Flats and the oasis)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.3: Relight The Oasis Beacon: follow the stars of the constellation (at the beacon, with your Star Lens)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.4: Cheer up Mother Spring, the gray water spirit under the Mother Palm on the shore of the oasis
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.5: Walk to the foot of The Star-Snuffing Tower, on the little rock next to the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.doel.6: Go back to Mother Spring on the shore of the Mother Oasis
She fled upstairs. To her Empty Lens. That's where she sits now, with her rings full of my stars.
That door won't open for one knight alone. A ring lock. It takes at least two. More is better.
But look around you. The water flows again. The caravans are singing. The stars are back.
Kneel for a moment. I have no crown, but I have water. That's better.
I hereby dub you Knight of the Silklands. With a splash. That part is mandatory.
There you are! Just look around. Every caravan in Saffron Gate. All of them. They're coming along.
With three beacons lit, they dare again. And with you along, they'd dare anything. Lumpy is wearing her prettiest bells.
First the Dune Beacon, on the highest dune. Then we follow the stars. La-la-LAA-la-lo. Onward!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_hq10_moederoase.tekst: The great caravan travels by night along the star path to the Mother Oasis. Light the Dune Beacon and the Oasis Beacon, find Mother Spring and look the Ring Finger's tower in the eye.
Lumpkin turns one today! Well, one hump. She counts in humps.
I'm baking a date cake, but I'm missing three things: dates, honey and flour. They're somewhere on the square. I forget everything.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.bezig: Three cake ingredients on Rose Square, and then to the party table.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.doel.0: Collect 3 cake ingredients on Rose Square (dates, honey, flour): look for the golden sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.doel.1: Bring the date cake to the party table next to the fountain on Rose Square
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.klaar.0: Look at her munch! She's got cake on her hump. On both of them, actually. She only has one.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.klaar.1: Thank you, knight. Lumpkin thinks you're sweet. She ate your shoe. That's a compliment.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s01_verjaardag.tekst: Lumpkin, Granny Date's baby humpguh, is having a birthday. There has to be a date cake. And a party.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.aanbod.0: Three gardens, three ledges, one watering can. And I'm afraid of heights. What a career choice.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.aanbod.1: Will you climb the wall stairs? First the west wall, then across the arch bridge to the east wall, and then all the way to the top.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.bezig: The three hanging gardens on the ledges of Rose Gorge.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.doel.0: Water the hanging garden on the first ledge (west wall)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.doel.1: Water the hanging garden on the second ledge (east wall, across the stone arch bridge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.doel.2: Water the hanging garden on the edge of the plateau (across the rope bridge)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.klaar.0: They're blooming! Look, they're bending toward you. That's a rose hug.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.klaar.1: Take these seeds. Desert roses. They grow everywhere. Except where you plant them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s02_tuinen.tekst: The hanging gardens of Rose Gorge hang over three ledges. They're thirsty, and the wall stairs are steep.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.aanbod.0: Six letters. Six doors. Three ledges. Two little paws. That doesn't add up.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.aanbod.1: Will you deliver them? The little mailboxes sparkle yellow when you get close.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.bezig: Six letters for the cliff houses on the ledges.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.doel.0: Deliver 6 letters to the cliff houses on the ledges of Rose Gorge: look for the mailboxes with the yellow sparkle
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.klaar.0: All delivered! A letter even came back. For you. 'Thank you, from the neighbors.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.klaar.1: Here, a stamp with a humpguh on it. Very rare. I only have six hundred.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s03_post.tekst: Postguh Stamp has six letters for cliff houses on different ledges. Her little paws are tired.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.aanbod.0: My tassels! They blew away. They wanted to fly, just like the carpets.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.aanbod.1: Five of them. On the rooftops, in the bazaar and by the canal. With your carpet you can reach them easily.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.doel.0: Find 5 carpet tassels in Saffron Gate (rooftops, bazaar, canal): look for the rainbow sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.klaar.0: All five! They're a bit dusty, but they're home. I'll make something pretty out of them. For your carpet.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.klaar.1: Rainbow tassels. Look at them flutter. Your carpet is now the prettiest in the city. After mine.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s04_kwastjes.tekst: Carpet Weaver Button's tassels have blown away all over Saffron Gate: onto rooftops, into the bazaar and along the canal.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.aanbod.0: Ah, a new face! Do you know how to haggle in Saffron Gate? No? Then I'll teach you.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.aanbod.1: Haggle grumpy, pay more. Haggle nicely, get a discount and a friend. Give it a try. With me, with Pistachio and with Delight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.bezig: Haggle nicely with Cardamom, Pistachio and Delight (talk to them: the tracker points them out).
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.doel.0: Haggle nicely with Trader Cardamom, at the spice stall under the big dome of the bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.doel.1: Haggle nicely with Trader Pistachio, at the stall with the pots and baskets in the bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.doel.2: Haggle nicely with Jeweler Delight, at the little glass stall in the bazaar
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.klaar.0: Three traders, three friends, and not one grumpy mustache. You're a true Haggler.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.klaar.1: You may wear that title. Everyone in the bazaar knows now: you're someone they can deal with.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s05_afdingen.tekst: In the Grand Bazaar, haggling is part of the deal. But whoever haggles nicely gets the biggest discount. Try it with three traders.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.aanbod.0: Hear that? Nothing. That's the problem. A noria is supposed to sing. Creeee-aak, creeee-aak.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.aanbod.1: The river is so low that the wheels are full of sand. Will you check them? Three of them. I'm too old for the quay.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.bezig: The three norias along the river.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.doel.0: Grease the western noria on the south bank of the Saffron River
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.doel.1: Straighten the gears of the big noria next to the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.doel.2: Clear the sand out of the eastern noria on the north bank, past the Paradise Garden
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.klaar.0: Creeee-aak! Creeee-aak! They're singing again! Hear that? It's the most beautiful song in the city.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.klaar.1: My teeth don't ache anymore. Thank you, knight.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s06_norias.tekst: The three big waterwheels of Saffron Gate don't creak anymore. They've stopped. Millguh Creak can feel it in his teeth.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.aanbod.0: Quack! Quack! Quack! They're all called Quack. And they're all gone.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.aanbod.1: They're floating in the little canals. If you fly low over the water on your carpet, you can grab them.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.bezig: Ten rubber ducks in the Canal Quarter.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.doel.0: Catch 10 rubber ducks in the little canals of the Canal Quarter (on your carpet, low over the water): look for the yellow splashes
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.klaar.0: All ten! Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack, Quack and... Quack! You're the best.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.klaar.1: You can keep one. His name is Quack.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.tekst: Little Pip's ten rubber ducks have drifted off through the little canals of the Canal Quarter.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s07_eendjes.titel: Rubber Ducks in the Canal Quarter
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.aanbod.0: A real stargazer knows the constellations by heart. Well, from a little book. That counts too.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.aanbod.1: Four spots, four constellations. The last one is in Rose Gorge. That's where you see the Little Crown best.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.bezig: Four constellations at four high spots.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.0: Connect The Little Fluff on the roof of Twinkle's Observatory
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.1: Connect The Great Snuggle on the top gallery of the Saffron Bridge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.2: Connect The Flying Humpguh on the western minaret of the Raisin Palace
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.doel.3: Connect The Little Crown on the Sea Mouth Pier in Rose Gorge
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.klaar.0: You passed! With an A+. Well, an A. At the Great Snuggle you stepped on my toe for a moment.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.klaar.1: Did you know the Little Fluff, the Great Snuggle and the Flying Humpguh are the oldest constellations? They say they've turned gray in the tower. I can't bear to think about it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s08_examen.tekst: Twinkle wants to know if you're a real stargazer. Four constellations, four high spots.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.aanbod.0: My dates! Gone! The date monkeys pinched them. They throw them at me when I come to look.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.aanbod.1: They hide them in baskets high up in the palms. Six baskets. Get them back. Duck!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.bezig: Six baskets of dates in the palm grove.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.doel.0: Find 6 baskets of pinched dates in the palm grove below the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges: look for the brown sparkles
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.klaar.0: My dates! All of them! And you didn't even get a date to the head. Or did you? You've got a bump.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.klaar.1: One of the little monkeys is following you, I see. He likes you. That's a good sign.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s09_dadelapen.tekst: A gang of date monkeys has pinched Datepit's date harvest and hidden it in the palms.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.aanbod.0: Three waterfalls, from bottom to top. I do it in three minutes. With a wet tail.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.aanbod.1: With a carpet you're faster. Or you take a dunk. One of the two. Ready? Splash away!
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.doel.0: Start at the lowest waterfall of the Palm Gorges
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.doel.1: On to the middle waterfall, behind the curtain of water
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.doel.2: And all the way up, to the top waterfall below the Palm Beacon
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.klaar.0: You're here already? And you're almost dry! That's a record. A new record. My record.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.klaar.1: Take this. A splash pennant. For the fastest courier of the gorges.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s10_koerier.tekst: Courier Splash delivers the mail along the waterfalls of the Palm Gorges. Can you do it faster?
Salt crayfish! They walk sideways, they snip everything to bits, and they think my little house is a party hall.
Catch five and take them far away. Flip them over and they're super sweet. And then we need to fix up my little house.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.bezig: Five salt crayfish, and fixing up the saltmaker's hut.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.doel.0: Catch 5 little salt crayfish on the Salt Flats: look for the pink sparkles in the salt
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.doel.1: Repair the saltmaker's hut on the southern edge of the Salt Flats
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.klaar.0: My little house is standing again! Crooked, but it always was. It's a house with character.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.klaar.1: Hear that? Something is singing under the floor. The Salt Cave. Come back tomorrow and I'll tell you about it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s11_zoutkreeft.tekst: Salt crayfish threw a party in Saltmaker Grainy's hut. The little house is half collapsed.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.aanbod.0: The Salt Cave sings. Each crystal one note. And behind a wall of crystal there's a chest, they say. From the First Caravan.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.aanbod.1: The wall only opens for the right song. The caravan song. Do you know it? Granny Date always hums it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.aanbod.2: And watch out for the Salt Serpent. It swims through the walls. Be gentle.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.bezig: The Singing Salt Cave, the caravan song on the crystals, and the chest of the First Caravan.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.doel.0: Enter the Singing Salt Cave, through the crack on the southern edge of the Salt Flats
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.doel.1: Play the caravan song on the singing crystals by the glowing little lake
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.doel.2: Open the chest of the First Caravan behind the crystal wall
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.klaar.0: The chest of the First Caravan! What was inside? A carpet pattern? The pattern of the First Caravan. What an honor.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.klaar.1: And a note: 'Whoever finds this, shares it. That's how it began. That's how it stays.' Lovely, isn't it?
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s12_zoutgrot.tekst: Under the Salt Flats lies the Singing Salt Cave. Behind a wall of crystal lies the chest of the First Caravan.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.aanbod.0: She always used to sing. When a caravan got lost, Wormelina sang the way. Now she only grumbles.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.aanbod.1: There's a gray salt crust on her back. Knock it off. Jump from a dune. She's big. Bring friends.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.bezig: Cheer up Queen Wormelina in the dunes.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.doel.0: Cheer up Queen Wormelina, in the heart of the Pink Dunes (field boss: bring friends)
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.klaar.0: She's singing again! Hear that? She's sleeping in the sand and she sings in her sleep.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.klaar.1: Look, she left this for you. A saddle blanket in pink. For your humpguh.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s13_wormelien.tekst: Queen Wormelina, the big pink sandworm who used to sing for the caravans, swims gray and hungry through the Pink Dunes.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.aanbod.0: Six tablets. Together they tell the story of the Star Guhs. I have zero. That's not many.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.aanbod.1: They sparkle blue when you're close. The stars marked them, I think. Or I did. I don't remember.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.doel.0: Find 6 stone tablets in Ruin Valley: look for the blue sparkles among the mesas
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.klaar.0: All six! I read: 'We counted the stars. One by one. And when we were done, we handed them out.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.klaar.1: And this one: 'There came a cat with a little crown. He counted too. But he did not share. He only counted what he had. Never enough.'
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.klaar.2: A cat with a little crown... That sounds like a fairy tale Mikas tell each other. Strange.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.tekst: Professor Dust is looking for six stone tablets of the old Star Guhs. They're scattered among the mesas of Ruin Valley.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s14_tabletten.titel: The Tablets of the Star Guhs
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.aanbod.0: Knight! It's me, Minnie! I came along with the whale, and then with a caravan. I wanted to help.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.aanbod.1: They come from the east, along the East Route. Just as skinny as I was back then. Give them soup. Soup always helps.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.bezig: A bowl of soup for three Unchonked.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.doel.0: Give a bowl of soup to 3 Unchonked at the refugee tents on the east side of the Mother Oasis
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.klaar.0: Look at them eat. They're already turning a little pink. Just like me back then.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.klaar.1: More are coming. I'm staying here. Someone has to stir the soup. And I'm good at it.
vadsrijk.npc.q.z6_s15_oostroute.tekst: Along the East Route, Unchonked come from the east to the Mother Oasis. Skinny Minnie from Highchonk takes them in.
